races.race_name: Coral Rewards Shaker Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Infraad
runners.spotlight: Won 1m2f maiden at Pontefract (1m2f, good) in April on third start and he was third on recent handicap debut at Chester (10.3f, good) where not much went right, as he was slowly away, failed to settle and denied a clear run before staying on strongly; this close relation to Group 1 winner Nezwaah could be quite a bit better than his current mark, especially now at 1m4f.
runners.comment: Not much went right when 3rd on handicap debut; could be quite a bit better than his mark

runners.name: Hatteen
runners.spotlight: Runner-up twice in a row (1m2f, good; including behind Bay Royale) before showing improved form for the step up in trip and getting off the mark at the fifth attempt in a novice at Doncaster (1m4f, good to firm) three weeks ago; he was impressive last time and is just the type of 3yo from this yard to keep on progressing; firmly in calculations on handicap debut.
runners.comment: Impressive at Doncaster and is just the type of 3yo from this yard to keep on progressing

runners.name: Tierra Del Toro
runners.spotlight: Merely ninth of 19 in the King George V Stakes at Royal Ascot (1m4f, good to firm) but he failed to settle and prior to that he kept on for a good third in the London Gold Cup at Newbury (1m2f, good) on his handicap and seasonal debut, shaping as though 1m4f could be right up his street; retains potential at this trip and could be a contender if settling better.
runners.comment: Failed to settle when ninth at Royal Ascot; promising third in London Gold Cup previously

runners.name: Parisian Scholar
runners.spotlight: Capitalised on a reduced mark at Thirsk (1m4f, good to firm) on July 1 and he followed up at Newmarket (1m4f, good to firm) ten days later; clearly in good heart but those wins came in five-runner, Class 4 handicaps and this is a much sterner test of his credentials.
runners.comment: He's won his last two although those were five-runner, Class 4 handicaps; this is hotter

runners.name: Baltic Fleet
runners.spotlight: Third of 14 on handicap debut at York (1m4f, good) in May and the form of his subsequent second of four at Wolverhampton (1m4f, AW) has worked out well; sold out of George Boughey's yard for £170,000 last month and he's in with an each-way shout on this first run for Ian Williams.
runners.comment: Strong form in defeat in his two handicaps and has an each-way shout on stable debut

runners.name: Sea And Sun
runners.spotlight: Beaten just a neck at Pontefract (1m4f, good) last month on his second start before 5l fourth of eight to Hatteen at Doncaster (1m4f, good to firm); he's 8lb better off with the winner for this handicap debut and further improvement is possible, but it's needed in this warm contest and there's a suspicion he may appreciate a longer trip.
runners.comment: Has shown considerable promise; handicap debut; suspicion he may appreciate a longer trip

runners.name: Blue Hercules
runners.spotlight: Prominent racer who was runner-up in Chepstow novice (1m2f, good to firm) in May on his third start and bounced back from heavy defeat in Royal Ascot handicap (80-1) when going close at Ascot (1m4f, good to firm) this month; could give another good account but others may have greater potential.
runners.comment: Went close at Ascot latest; could give good account but others may have greater potential

runners.name: Cannes
runners.spotlight: Runner-up to notable rivals on first two starts before winning 1m4f maiden at Leopardstown (good) in May; well beaten when favourite on handicap debut in the King George V Stakes at Royal Ascot (1m4f, good to firm) but he raced in the rear and things didn't go his way tactically; Irish stable won this last year and he might be worth another chance.
runners.comment: Favourite when well beaten in Royal Ascot handicap but things didn't go his way tactically
runners.owner: Al Shaqab Racing & Stall Perlen AB

runners.name: Bay Royale
runners.spotlight: Won at Nottingham (1m2f, good) in April on second start and runner-up in novice there (1m2f, good to soft) in May when last seen; he's not obviously well treated off his opening mark but this 220,000gns yearling is bred to be suited by 1m4f and is open to further improvement; wears a first-time tongue-tie; one to watch in the betting.
runners.comment: Not obviously well treated off opening mark but bred to be suited by the step up to 1m4f

races.race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Alice Keppel Fillies' Conditions Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Wild Blossom
runners.spotlight: Stormed home to win by 10l on her debut at Carlisle (good) in May but she couldn't produce similar fireworks in the Queen Mary (also 5f, good to firm) last time; however, she was still beaten only about 4l that day in what looked a good renewal; the pick of James Doyle and she's a player.
runners.comment: Stormed home on debut and beaten only 4l in Queen Mary; the pick of two from James Doyle

runners.name: Fast Track
runners.spotlight: Solid third on her debut over C&D in May and her narrow second at Nottingham next time has been well advertised by the winner subsequently; midfield in the Group 2 Queen Mary last month but made no mistake when effortlessly taking Beverley novice (5f, good to firm; first-time tongue-tie) a fortnight ago; yard could hardly be in better form; respected.
runners.comment: Midfield in the Queen Mary last month but bolted up last time; yard flying; respected

runners.name: Miss Lizzy
runners.spotlight: Narrowly opened her account when taking AW maiden (6f) in May; she's fine on turf and posted good efforts in a French Listed race and the Queen Mary (head behind Wild Blossom) at Royal Ascot before respectable third in Sandown Listed event (5f, good) four weeks ago; that latest form has taken a few knocks but she can't be ruled out.
runners.comment: A head behind Wild Blossom in Queen Mary; Listed third latest; can't be ruled out

runners.name: Princesse d'Orange
runners.spotlight: All starts at 5f; a commanding win on her debut at Beverley (good to soft; made all) in April promised plenty but she's not really kicked on; fairly close third in Sandown Listed event in May was potentially a run to build on but she weakened to be beaten about 10l in the Queen Mary last time; Ryan Moore takes the reins and this filly is not discounted if tapping back into that initial promise.
runners.comment: Commanding win on her debut (good to soft) but hasn't kicked on; Ryan Moore takes over

runners.name: Zigazig Ah
runners.spotlight: She got off the mark over 6f at Yarmouth in June and was up late to bag a valuable sales race at Newbury (good to firm) when dropped to 5f 11 days ago; this easier 5f isn't sure to suit but a solid pace looks likely, which will help, and she's progressing.
runners.comment: Won a big pot 11 days ago; this easier 5f a query but good pace likely & she's progressing

runners.name: Call Nicki
runners.spotlight: The door opened on her fifth start when landing Hamilton maiden (5f) in June and she showed improved form to romp away with three-runner nursery over that C&D (also good to firm; made all) a fortnight ago; this is much tougher but she's putting it together and might get them at it.
runners.comment: Maiden win followed by nursery romp; this is much tougher but she might get them at it

runners.name: Hidden Gift
runners.spotlight: Caught the eye when second on her debut at Ripon (5f, good) near the start of last month and it was a fine effort from the front when fifth in the Group 3 Albany (6f, good to firm) two weeks later; appeared to find the latter trip a stretch and today's drop back to 5f looks a good move.
runners.comment: Fine effort when 5th in Albany (6f, good to firm); drop back to 5f looks a good move

runners.name: Divine Whisper
runners.spotlight: Really promising debut when bustling up an odds-on shot at York (good) last month but she wasn't overly impressive when justifying short odds at Windsor (also 5f, good to firm) a fortnight later; will need to better that effort but it's still very early days.
runners.comment: Wasn't overly impressive when justifying short odds latest; needs better but early days

runners.name: Envision
runners.spotlight: Made virtually all when she took a Windsor novice (5f, good to firm; first-time blinkers) with authority at the start of last month; those tactics were always going to be hard to pull off when 150-1 and down the field in the Queen Mary 16 days later but they will be better deployed at this venue, albeit pace pressure looks likely.
runners.comment: Made all in first-time blinkers last month; down the field in Queen Mary 16 days later

races.race_name: Rolls-Royce Oak Tree Stakes (Group 3) (Fillies & Mares)

runners.name: Zanthos
runners.spotlight: Down the field in Group 1s on her two starts this season, specifically the French 1,000 Guineas and the Commonwealth Cup at Royal Ascot; however, today's drop back in grade and first-time tongue-tie could prompt an upturn in fortunes, and she made virtually all to win the Group 2 Rockfel Stakes at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) last September; can have a big say if back on song.
runners.comment: Down the field in two Group 1s this year but respected on account of her 2yo Group 2 win

runners.name: Flora Of Bermuda
runners.spotlight: Classy 6f performer who has been placed in Group 1s at that trip and she won a Group 3 at York (6f, good to firm) this month, for which she carries a 3lb penalty today; untested at 7f but she frequently finishes her races strongly, as was the case when fourth in the 2024 Group 1 Prix Maurice de Gheest at Deauville over 6.5f; leading contender if staying the trip.
runners.comment: 6f Group 3 winner at York this month & there can be optimism that 7f will be within range

runners.name: Sayidah Dariyan
runners.spotlight: Won the Group 3 Summer Stakes at York (6f, good) last July and she's run well in defeat on both starts this season, finishing third to Flora Of Bermuda at Newmarket (6f, good to firm; Listed) before 3l ninth of 18 in the Group 1 Jubilee Stakes at Royal Ascot (6f, good to firm); stays well over 6f and this new trip is worth a go; major player if stamina isn't an issue.
runners.comment: 6f Group 3 winner and she stays well at that trip; major player if stamina isn't an issue

runners.name: Planet Seeker
runners.spotlight: Won on debut here (6f, good) last August and beaten on next two starts (6f; including Group 3) before convincing handicap win at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) this month; this is a much tougher test of her credentials but she impressed last time and her dam was a Group 3 winner; trainer saddled two 3yos to dead-heat for first in this race 12 months ago; one to consider.
runners.comment: Impressive handicap win at Newmarket and she's one to consider despite the rise in grade

runners.name: Royal Velvet
runners.spotlight: 5yo who was a big improver at the start of this season, winning a handicap at Newmarket (7f, good) then the Group 3 Chartwell Stakes at Lingfield (7f, good to firm); however, it appears as though she may have gone off the boil on her last two outings; carries a 3lb penalty this afternoon.
runners.comment: Group 3 winner at Lingfield in May but it appears as though she may have gone off the boil

runners.name: Isle Of Fernandez
runners.spotlight: Placed in two Group 3 races (6f/7f, soft/good to soft) and ran well for a long way when eighth of 15 in the French 1,000 Guineas at Longchamp (1m, heavy) in May; drops back in grade today and the return to 7f could also help, but others have stronger claims; unproven on good/good to firm.
runners.comment: Eighth in French 1,000 Guineas; drops back in trip/grade but others have stronger claims

runners.name: Orion's Belt
runners.spotlight: Best 2yo performance came when runner-up in the Group 3 Dick Poole Stakes over 6f at Salisbury last September; flopped in the Group 1 Cheveley Park at Newmarket a fortnight later and absent since; her form needs to go to a new level on this comeback outing.
runners.comment: Runner-up in 2yo Group 3 last September; form needs to go to a new level on this comeback

runners.name: Awaken
runners.spotlight: Ran well in fourth behind Zanthos in the Group 2 Rockfel Stakes at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) last September on her final 2yo start; however, well beaten on both outings this season and needs to get back on track.
runners.comment: Placed in 2yo Group races last season but well beaten on both outings this term

runners.name: Brazilian Rose
runners.spotlight: Four handicap wins at Southwell (7f/6f, AW) early this year; however, unplaced in Listed races on turf on her three outings this summer and she's up against it today.
runners.comment: Four AW handicap wins this year but unplaced in Listed turf races on her last three starts

runners.name: Radiant Beauty
runners.spotlight: She's thrived since joining this yard and made it 4-7 for the stable when making all in a Listed race at Pontefract (1m, good) three weeks ago; today's company demands further improvement but she might still have more to offer and could make another bold bid.
runners.comment: Listed winner last time; this demands further improvement but she's very much on the up

runners.name: Golden Palace
runners.spotlight: Won 2yo novice races last July on her first two starts and has run well in defeat in some Group and Listed races since, but she hasn't shown enough to suggest she'll be a serious contender in this.
runners.comment: 0-5 in Group/Listed races since winning 2yo novice races last July on her first two starts

runners.name: Havana Pusey
runners.spotlight: C&D handicap winner who was third to Royal Velvet in a Group 3 at Lingfield (7f, good to firm) in May; however, this exposed 6yo faces a tougher assignment in today's line-up and was ninth of 13 in this race 12 months ago; blew the start at Newmarket last time; hood/tongue-tie are applied.
runners.comment: Third in Group 3 in May but this exposed 6yo faces a tougher assignment today

runners.name: Dash Of Azure
runners.spotlight: She's gone close in Listed races at Chester (7f, good) on her last two starts, beaten just a neck last time when having to challenge wide; she might not be far away.
runners.comment: Has gone close in Listed races at Chester on last two starts and she might not be far away

runners.name: Queen's Reign
runners.spotlight: Went very close in big-field Listed race at Deauville (7.5f, AW) last December and she may have needed the run when sixth of seven at Longchamp in April on her return (7f, good to soft; Listed); however, a clear career-best is necessary if she's to make a serious impact this afternoon.
runners.comment: Has run well in defeat in Listed races but a clear career-best is needed this afternoon

races.race_name: Veuve Clicquot Molecomb Stakes (Group 3)

runners.name: Pershaada
runners.spotlight: Beaten favourite in two AW attempts; has shown marked improvement since switched to turf, winning a C&D novice contest (good) then running well in the Queen Mary at Royal Ascot (5f, good to firm) where she was one place in front of Crownbreaker; strong claims.
runners.comment: Scored over C&D on turf debut, then ran well in the Queen Mary at Royal Ascot; good claims

runners.name: Crownbreaker
runners.spotlight: No match for impressive winner in her second start but has shown useful 5f form since, belying her 100-1 odds with good fifth in the Queen Mary then bagging Listed honours at Deauville; ties in closely with Pershaada on the Royal Ascot effort; major contender.
runners.comment: Ties in with Pershaada on Queen Mary running; bagged Listed honours at Deauville since

runners.name: El Floridita
runners.spotlight: Redcar maiden winner who changed ownership for £100,000 prior to belying his 150-1 odds with second-place finish in the Norfolk at Royal Ascot (5f, good to firm) last time; this thrice-raced colt is one of the main contenders, provided the latest effort is backed up.
runners.comment: One of the main players, provided the form of his 150-1 second in the Norfolk is confirmed

runners.name: Sale Shark
runners.spotlight: Won at Hamilton (5f) then ran well in the Windsor Castle at Royal Ascot (6f) but probably showed no further progress at Newbury last time; this assignment demands a bigger figure.
runners.comment: Showed no further progress last time; this assignment demands a bigger figure

runners.name: Brazilian Diva
runners.spotlight: Irish challenger; has displayed major improvement since dropped back to 5f, winning a maiden then going close in Listed event, both at Naas on good ground; may have more to offer over this trip; not ruled out.
runners.comment: Irish challenger; has shown major improvement since dropped back to 5f; not ruled out

runners.name: Undercover Affair
runners.spotlight: Record is 2-9, the wins in C&D seller in June and Windsor nursery last time; proving consistent but looks out of his depth upped sharply in class.
runners.comment: Gained his wins in C&D seller and Windsor nursery; out of his depth upped in class

runners.name: Adonius
runners.spotlight: Speedy gelding who defied top weight in the Lily Agnes at Chester (5f, good) when last seen, taking record to 3-3; runner-up has franked that form since; sidestepped Royal Ascot and comes here fresh; respected with this scenario likely to suit and further progress possible.
runners.comment: Lily Agnes winner who remains unbeaten and comes here fresh having sidestepped Royal Ascot

runners.name: Flight Signal
runners.spotlight: Looked promising in winning well at Bath (5f, good to firm); soundly beaten in the Norfolk since but perhaps that assignment was too much too soon; may still have progress in him.
runners.comment: Won well at Bath; soundly beaten in the Norfolk but may still have progress in him

runners.name: Ruler's Pride
runners.spotlight: 550,000gns breeze-up buy who comfortably beat two rivals to win at Ayr (5f, good to firm) and was hampered en route to fading over 6f in the Coventry at Royal Ascot (eased once held; better than the bare result); retains potential and remains of interest back down in distance.
runners.comment: 550,000gns breeze-up buy who retains potential and remains of interest back down in trip

runners.name: Hell Of A Spin
runners.spotlight: Unexposed but the form of his neck success at Hamilton (5f, good) last time is well below Group standard; indeed he's bottom of this pack on the figures.
runners.comment: Unexposed but the form of his Hamilton win is well below Group standard

runners.name: Bill The Bull
runners.spotlight: Steadily progressive until form dipped in last two outings, only midfield with tongue-tie fitted in the Super Sprint latest; chance depends on how well he responds to the addition of blinkers.
runners.comment: Steadily progressive until form dipped in last two outings; blinkers added

races.race_name: Visit Qatar Sussex Stakes (Group 1)

runners.name: Opera Ballo
runners.spotlight: Largely progressive colt whose strike-rate of 7-10 includes wins this year at Meydan (Group 1) and Sandown (made all for a particularly good Group 2 performance under a penalty); collared only towards the finish by Ten Bob Tony and one other rival in the Queen Anne at Royal Ascot (good to firm) most recently, deserving credit having set a solid pace over that stiff 1m; flexible tactically and doesn't necessarily need to front-run; the pick of the older runners on ratings and duly commands respect.
runners.comment: Largely progressive; record is 7-10; led for very long way in the Queen Anne last time

runners.name: Bow Echo
runners.spotlight: Only scraped home from a closing Gstaad in the St James's Palace Stakes at Royal Ascot (good to firm) last time but the race didn't go fully smoothly and he also perhaps hit the front sooner than ideal over that stiff 1m; beat that rival more impressively at Newmarket on reappearance to become, on RPRs, the joint-best 2,000 Guineas winner since Frankel; still unbeaten (5-5) and, given his general trajectory, remains an exciting miler who could dominate this division for the rest of the season.
runners.comment: Winner of the 2,000 Guineas and St James's Palace Stakes this season; still unbeaten
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid

runners.name: Gstaad
runners.spotlight: Rock-solid performer whose success in the Irish 2,000 Guineas is flanked by good efforts behind Bow Echo at Newmarket (beaten almost 3l, pair well clear) and Royal Ascot (nearly collared him); admittedly the bare result last time may not be fully reliable, given the way the race panned out and the stiff 1m; however, this smart colt is certainly reliable, having never finished out of the first two, and is again an important player in another rematch with his nemesis.
runners.comment: Rock-solid performer who is again an important player in another rematch with Bow Echo
runners.owner: Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor

runners.name: Seagulls Eleven
runners.spotlight: Better than ever this season, most recently a close third in Group 2 at Ascot (1m, good to firm) when bidding for a hat-trick after wins at Longchamp (Listed) and Epsom (Group 3); landed the Group 3 Thoroughbred Stakes at this meeting 12 months ago; faces a tougher task in this top grade but could go well in his current form.
runners.comment: Won at this meeting last year; better than ever; back to top grade now but could go well
runners.owner: Two Plus Three Two Plus Four

runners.name: Never So Brave
runners.spotlight: Proved somewhat resurgent with second-place finish behind Qirat over 7f at York last time, the C&D of his Group 1 success last August; however, faces a stiffer assignment back up in trip/class and possibly isn't crying out for this return to 1m, despite being a distance winner.
runners.comment: Somewhat resurgent last time but faces a stiffer assignment back up in trip/class

runners.name: Puerto Rico
runners.spotlight: Ran creditably in the Poulains on seasonal debut when bidding for a French Group 1 hat-trick; dropped away to finish last of six, having been pestered for the lead, in the St James's Palace Stakes since; that latest effort doesn't reflect his ability but he's again the stable second string behind Gstaad and remains below the standard required to win this prize.
runners.comment: Again the stable second string behind Gstaad and is below the required standard
runners.owner: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith

runners.name: Zavateri
runners.spotlight: Game colt whose record of 4-5 as a 2yo featured wins in the Vintage Stakes at this meeting and National Stakes at the Curragh; latter is one of two pieces of form that tie him in with Gstaad; respectable second in the Greenham at Newbury (kept to 7f) on reappearance but missed the 2,000 Guineas due to a setback; ready for a crack at 1m and, having raced only once this season, there's still some unfinished business about him; adds interest.
runners.comment: Game colt; ready for a crack at 1m and there's still some unfinished business about him

runners.name: Docklands
runners.spotlight: Grand campaigner but his last two efforts, including in the Queen Anne he'd won 12 months earlier, have spoiled an otherwise excellent record at Ascot which is the place he's most associated with; below best in both Goodwood attempts, latest when fifth of seven in this race last year; opposed.
runners.comment: Last two efforts have spoiled his otherwise excellent record at Ascot; opposed

runners.name: Lake Forest
runners.spotlight: Gelded prior to this season's impressive win at Haydock (7f Listed) and respectable fifth at Royal Ascot (6f Group 1); his 1m form comprises a respectable fifth in the 2025 Queen Anne and two lesser efforts on Australian soil; still needs to prove he's a genuine miler but he arrived late to win the 7f Group 2 Lennox here yesterday and is probably in the form of his life.
runners.comment: Probably in the form of his life (won yesterday) but has something to prove back up to 1m

runners.name: Ten Bob Tony
runners.spotlight: Came off the good pace set by Opera Ballo when 50-1 winner of the Queen Anne at Royal Ascot (1m, good to firm) last time, completing a quickfire June double that was initiated over 7f at Epsom; still unexposed as a miler and has frame possibilities provided the latest piece of form is backed up.
runners.comment: Has frame possibilities, provided the form of his 50-1 win in the Queen Anne is backed up

runners.name: Dorset
runners.spotlight: Ended last season with a couple of notable wins but broadly hasn't been in the same form this term and is currently well down the pecking order at Ballydoyle, as his rating reflects; bottom of this pack on said figures and is possibly in here to help with pacemaking duties for Gstaad.
runners.comment: Bottom of this pack on ratings and is possibly in here to help with pacemaking duties

runners.name: Qirat
runners.spotlight: Prevailed in York Group 3 when dropped back to 7f last month, benefiting from the first application of a tongue-tie, and rallied for fourth behind Lake Forest in 7f Group 2 Lennox here yesterday; well suited by Goodwood but he was a fluky 150-1 winner of this race last year, having been allowed too much rope in a pacemaking duty, and seems unlikely to repeat the feat.
runners.comment: Suited by Goodwood (4th here yesterday) but was a fluky winner of this race last year

races.race_name: Coral Charlton Handicap

runners.name: Supreme King
runners.spotlight: Took advantage of a lowly mark at Southwell in December and he has flourished since, adding two more AW wins over the winter and going in again at Salisbury (6f, soft) last month; runner-up on all three outings since and likely to give it another good shot.
runners.comment: In fine form, following June's Salisbury win with three successive runner-up efforts

runners.name: Calling A Star
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the sixth attempt at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) in February and returned to form with a gutsy handicap win at Windsor (6f, good to firm) last month; bettered that form when fourth of 11 in 7f 3yo handicap at the Newmarket July meeting and the form-figures of the four who have run out of that race since are 1113; considered under Buick.
runners.comment: Gutsy winner over 6f in June and form of latest 7f Newmarket fourth boosted; considered
runners.owner: A Smith, J Henwood & Star Amusements

runners.name: French Affair
runners.spotlight: Has drawn a blank since his 6f nursery debut success at Newbury last year but he did go close in 20-runner York handicap (7f, good) in May; bit below that level in two 7f outings last month but new connections went to 55,000gns to acquire him recently and Billy Loughnane has been booked.
runners.comment: New yard bought him for 55,000gns recently; check betting with Loughnane booked

runners.name: Cotai Lights
runners.spotlight: Wide-margin winner of 6f AW novice as 2yo but best handicap form has come at 7f and he's finished nearer last than first over 6f on his last two starts; first-time blinkers need to help.
runners.comment: Down the field back at 6f the last twice and first-time blinkers need to help

runners.name: Ziggy's Condor
runners.spotlight: All wins for former yard came over 6f; didn't run badly on stable debut at Yarmouth but well beaten at Doncaster since (both 7f); first-time blinkers go on (regularly wore cheekpieces/visor for previous stable).
runners.comment: Not an obvious one based on two 7f runs for Adam Kirby; new headgear goes on

runners.name: Silver Wraith
runners.spotlight: Made all off today's mark on seasonal debut at Bath (5.7f, firm) in April; one of best runs since when 2l second of eight at Newbury (6f, good to firm) last week.
runners.comment: Made all off this mark in the spring; creditable second over 6f at Newbury since

runners.name: Winchurch
runners.spotlight: Made it three wins in his last five starts when seeing off five rivals at Nottingham (5f, good to firm) four weeks ago; at the top of his game but this asks a different question of one who has gained all six career successes in single-figure fields.
runners.comment: In top form with three recent wins but all six career successes in single-figure fields
runners.owner: SBK Racing & B & J Parr Racing Ltd

runners.name: Sargent Dennis
runners.spotlight: All races at 6f, taking a step forward for the switch to turf when well on top from two subsequent winners in 6f Windsor maiden (good to firm) in May; a bit disappointing on last Thursday's Doncaster handicap debut but possible he needed it after ten weeks off; remains unexposed.
runners.comment: Well held on recent handicap debut but may have needed it after break; remains unexposed

runners.name: Velvet Rhythm
runners.spotlight: Four 7f handicap wins on good/good to firm since May; travelled well in lead for long way when third of six off this mark at Newbury (7f, good to firm) 11 days ago; three of her wins were gained at sharp Cattrerick and she could be speedy enough to cope with a drop back to 6f.
runners.comment: In good form over 7f since handicapping and looks speedy enough for 6f
runners.owner: Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed Al Maktoum

runners.name: Riley Rocks
runners.spotlight: Started 2026 with 6f AW wins at Newcastle (novice) and Southwell (handicap); best run on turf since when fourth of 11 to the reopposing Calling A Star at Windsor (6f, good to firm) six weeks ago; subsequently gelded and also fitted with a first-time tongue-tie.
runners.comment: Two AW wins; best turf run when fourth to Calling A Star latest; gelded and tongue-tie on

runners.name: Expert Agent
runners.spotlight: Bounced back to form to win at Newmarket (6f, good) in May but two lesser runs have followed on the July Course there since.
runners.comment: Newmarket win in May but two lesser runs have followed
runners.owner: J P Morris, Mrs V A Tunnicliffe Et Al

runners.name: Rory Rocket
runners.spotlight: Can miss the break and is usually ridden from off the pace; back-to-back wins over the extended 5f at Brighton this summer, the latter by a wide margin under Jude Fernandes this month; below-form third turned out under a penalty at Salisbury (6f, good to firm) four days later and another 4lb higher now.
runners.comment: Two Brighton wins this summer but beaten at short odds latest and another  4lb higher now

runners.name: Kanishka
runners.spotlight: Running well in defeat in 7f/1m handicaps for Brian Ellison this year; changed hands for 34,000gns this month; shrewd new yard quick to drop him back in trip (peak RPRs last year achieved over 6f); worth a second look in the betting.
runners.comment: Running with credit over 7f/1m in 2026; shrewd new yard quick to drop him back in trip

runners.name: Mae Amor
runners.spotlight: Sprung a 66-1 shock on her seasonal return at Hamilton (6f, good) in May but sixth is the best she's managed in three outings since; back on the mark she defied at Hamilton but others are more persuasive.
runners.comment: Sprung 66-1 surprise on reappearance but sixth is the best she's managed since

runners.name: Cashbox
runners.spotlight: Ended his 2yo campaign with nursery wins over 6f/7f; unplaced first two runs in 2026 but back to his best in first-time cheekpieces (now replaced by the blinkers he wore on penultimate start) when second of seven at Leicester (7f, good to firm) 25 days ago.
runners.comment: Back to best when second over 7f latest and had winning form over 6f as a juvenile

runners.name: Lunar Melody
runners.spotlight: 500,000euros breeze-up purchase last year; left sole 2yo run behind when second over 7f at Doncaster (good to firm) on reappearance; faded over 7f on soft ground when only fifth at Carlisle since and the drop back to 6f could suit on handicap debut; unexposed contender for leading owners who target this meeting.
runners.comment: The drop back to 6f could suit this unexposed contender for owners who target this meeting

runners.name: Sir Garfield
runners.spotlight: Reappeared with a win at Catterick (6f, good) in April and then made all at Epsom (6f, good) this month; faded late on to finish sixth of seven at Hamilton since but he can be made to look well treated on the Epsom form (beat Amazing Journey) and his yard is no stranger to sprint handicap success at this meeting.
runners.comment: Defeat of Amazing Journey on penultimate run reads well and yard targets this meeting

runners.name: Tex
runners.spotlight: Placed six times (7f-1m2f) before making it 12th time lucky in 7f Ascot handicap (good to firm) last Friday; has a 5lb penalty and a new trip to contend with now.
runners.comment: Off mark in 7f Ascot handicap on Friday but has a 5lb penalty and new trip to contend with

runners.name: Charlie Mason
runners.spotlight: Showed career-best form when winning at Lingfield (6f, soft) under Myla Coppins last month but has failed to reproduce it twice since.
runners.comment: Career best to win under Myla Coppins at Lingfield last month but below par twice since

runners.name: Kesta
runners.spotlight: Won three times at two, including at Nottingham (6f, good to soft) off 3lb higher in October; he's performed below that level in his three outings this year but latest fifth over 5f here was a bit better and he should be suited by the return to 6f; no shock were he to bounce back to form with a bang.
runners.comment: Three wins at 2; below that level in three runs this year but he's well handicapped again

runners.name: Mythical Composer
runners.spotlight: Responded well to first-time cheekpieces (retained since) when successful over 7f at Kempton in December; no more than a respectable fourth back there (7f again) two months later and off since (has been gelded); Clive Cox is among the winners but others arrive with more pressing claims.
runners.comment: AW winner in December but off since fourth at Kempton in February; has been gelded

runners.name: Under The Twilight
runners.spotlight: Enhanced a good Windsor record when seeing off next-time-out winner Amazonian Dream and ten others over 6f on good to firm 16 days ago; a 5lb rise looks manageable, particularly as she went close off 4lb higher at this meeting last year; on the shortlist.
runners.comment: Latest Windsor win boosted and she went close off 4lb higher at this meeting last year

runners.name: Fresh Fade
runners.spotlight: 6f winner in Ireland last term but holds weak claims on his three efforts for new stable.
runners.comment: 6f winner in Ireland last term but holds weak claims on his three efforts for new yard

runners.name: Born Slippy
runners.spotlight: Lacks recent match practice and gained his sole win off 9lb lower but on the plus side his yard is enjoying a fine summer; worth a second look in the betting.
runners.comment: Off ten months and 9lb above sole winning mark but his yard is enjoying a good summer

runners.name: Arduis Invicta
runners.spotlight: Ran well for second at Musselburgh (5f, good) last month; respectable fourth of 14 at York (6f, good) since but she's yet to win from a mark in the 80s.
runners.comment: Second over 5f last month; fair fourth over 6f since but yet to win from mark in 80s

runners.name: Wreck It Ryley
runners.spotlight: The handicapper has been in command since his runaway win at Leicester (6f, good) in April; respectable sixth of 19 at York (6f, good to firm) 18 days ago but suspicion he'll prove vulnerable for win purposes again.
runners.comment: The handicapper has been in command since runaway win at Leicester in April

runners.name: Vingegaard
runners.spotlight: Held on grimly for a first success since his 2yo days (missed 2025) at Thirsk (6f, good) six weeks ago; only 2lb higher but that form has taken a few knocks since.
runners.comment: Held on grimly at Thirsk six weeks ago but the form has taken a few knocks since

races.race_name: HKJC World Pool Handicap

runners.name: Rhoscolyn
runners.spotlight: Bit of a legend down the years and his six wins here include two at Glorious Goodwood, namely a heavy-ground edition of this in 2023 and when bagging valuable Golden Mile (soft) last term; now 6lb lower but there's a reason for that and he could do with a downpour, which isn't forecast; has a good stall and Oisin Murphy retakes the reins, however, while that course record means he can never be overlooked.
runners.comment: Six wins here include two at Glorious; rain (not forecast) would help but he's well drawn

runners.name: Zarathos
runners.spotlight: He has taken it up a notch this season, winning at Windsor (1m, good to firm; made most) in May and beating 21 others under a penalty at York (7f, good) eight days later; fine second to Colombier at Epsom next time and his latest fifth in valuable Curragh handicap (1m) was respectable; has to be of interest again.
runners.comment: Improving 4yo; latest fifth in valuable Curragh handicap (1m) was respectable; of interest
runners.owner: J Sarkar, D Sarkar, O Sarkar & D Sarkar

runners.name: Crimson Spirit
runners.spotlight: Three wins last year and he won 14-runner handicap over C&D (good) in May; solid fourth to Colombier at Epsom next time and it was a narrow career best when second of 11 at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) 18 days ago; will probably need another pb but that's not out of the question and Ryan Moore rides; considered.
runners.comment: Won 14-runner h'cap over C&D in May; big run latest and Ryan Moore rides; considered

runners.name: Hunters Lullaby
runners.spotlight: Norwegian raider who has won from 5.5f to 1m1f in his homeland, including three wins on turf (6f, good); comes here in good nick having been beaten just a neck over this trip at Ovrevoll (good) three weeks ago but stall 17 isn't overly helpful; sports a hood.
runners.comment: Norwegian raider who has won from 5.5f to 1m1f in his homeland; stall 17 not ideal; hooded

runners.name: Humam
runners.spotlight: Scored at York for Andrew Balding on his last run in this grade; quite highly tried in seven starts for this yard but he was far from disgraced when third of five in a Swedish Listed event (7f, good) one month ago; tongue-tie added and he has one of the widest stalls to contend with, however.
runners.comment: Not disgraced in Swedish Listed (7f, good) latest; tongue-tie added and has a wide stall

runners.name: Divine Libra
runners.spotlight: Beaten on his last 16 starts going back to May 2024 and he didn't deliver on a hint he was on the way back at Chester in May when beaten 7l at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) 25 days ago; just 1lb above his last winning mark, however, and first-time blinkers might help him put his best foot forward.
runners.comment: 1lb above his last winning mark and first-time blinkers might help but others preferred

runners.name: The Liffey
runners.spotlight: He was making hay in AW claimers earlier in the year, winning three of his last four races (6f-1m) for Denis Hogan and he carried on the good work when taking a Kempton handicap (1m, AW) at 25-1 on his stable debut four weeks ago; up 4lb but he used to act on turf and can't be discounted from a good stall.
runners.comment: Won stable debut (AW) latest; up 4lb but used to act on turf ; well drawn & not discounted

runners.name: Bobby Bennu
runners.spotlight: Unraced at two but he scored twice around this trip on turf as a 3yo; built on his Chester comeback in May with neck second of 14 in fairly valuable Newcastle handicap (7f, AW) one month ago; that wasn't far off his best and he may still be capable of better; respected.
runners.comment: Built on May comeback with neck 2nd (7f, AW) one month ago; may yet do better; respected

runners.name: Silver Ghost
runners.spotlight: It was a convincing win when she beat 13 others to land a valuable handicap from 6lb lower over C&D (good) last May; this season started well with two placed efforts at Newmarket (7f, good to firm/good) in May but she disappointed when beaten 15l to finish last of 10 on the July course 25 days ago; that can probably be forgiven as she raced in a group that was never competitive.
runners.comment: C&D winner last May; form dipped last time but that can probably be forgiven

runners.name: Oliver Show
runners.spotlight: A couple of close calls led to a frustrating campaign last year but it was a good effort when a running-on fourth to Crimson Spirit over C&D (good) in May; not seen since but he's dipped below his last winning mark and this may have been the plan; big run might be on the cards.
runners.comment: Good effort over C&D (good) in May; absent since but he's nicely treated; big run possible

runners.name: Superposition
runners.spotlight: In good form since returning to turf in the spring, getting the better of Silver Ghost to score at Newmarket (good) in May before solid third on the July course (again 7f, good to firm) the following month; just caught out by a drop to 6f when fourth at Ascot 19 days ago but that form is working out well; player back at 7f with William Buick taking over.
runners.comment: In good form since returning to turf in the spring; latest 6f form is working out; player

runners.name: The Fingal Raven
runners.spotlight: Tends to reserve his best for Meydan and he hasn't landed a telling blow in valuable handicaps at Royal Ascot and Newmarket on his last two starts; well drawn and he drops in grade, though.
runners.comment: Well drawn and drops in grade but he tends to reserve his best for Meydan

runners.name: Rajeko
runners.spotlight: His two runner-up efforts in a Qatar conditions turf event and Lingfield Listed race (also 7f, AW) last spring would give him serious claims off this mark; didn't beat a rival in three subsequent handicaps but he had been gelded when showing more at Newcastle last time; that came after a 127-day break and he could go well at potentially big odds.
runners.comment: Old form gives him big claims and showed a bit more latest; could go well at tasty odds

runners.name: Goldmoyne
runners.spotlight: Eight-time winner who has been kept busy since joining this yard and he rattled off a four-timer on AW (7f/1m) earlier in the year; has been knocking on the door of late, including when close third of 17 at York (7f, good to firm; Pellitory second; Morte Point sixth) 19 days ago; firmly in the mix once again.
runners.comment: Keeps running well; close third of 17 (7f, good to firm) latest; firmly in the mix again

runners.name: Colombier
runners.spotlight: Very capable performer but he can race freely and has been in and out in four starts for this yard; beat Zarathos to take 7f handicap at Epsom (good to soft; Crimson Spirit fourth) on Oaks day and, following a lesser effort at Royal Ascot, he was back in respectable form when fifth in the Bunbury Cup (good to firm; first-time hood) this month; James Doyle sticks with him but no hood today and has the widest stall.
runners.comment: Won 7f h'cap at Epsom in June; respectable fifth latest but no hood today & widest stall

runners.name: Hawksbill
runners.spotlight: Just one novice stakes win for Hugo Palmer but recorded plenty of good efforts, including when he split two subsequent Group winners in a 1m conditions race here (good) last May; didn't run badly in three of four starts in Meydan for this yard earlier in the year, but his British return from a 111-day break was underwhelming last month; might have needed that and he's not badly treated.
runners.comment: Might have needed it on his return from Meydan at Newmarket last month; not badly treated

runners.name: Pellitory
runners.spotlight: Three-time 7f turf winner who finished eighth of 16 in the 3yo handicap over C&D at this meeting last year for James Owen; had been gelded before finishing down the field in first two starts for this yard but was close to career-best form when second of 17 at York (7f, good to firm) 19 days ago; that was a bunch finish but 1lb nudge still looks reasonable; considered despite tricky stall.
runners.comment: Close to career best when 2nd (7f, good to firm) latest; considered despite tricky stall

runners.name: Defence Minister
runners.spotlight: Finished a fairly close fourth in this last year (good) when the pick of James Doyle from three Wathnan runners; had been gelded before taking a 7f handicap at Kempton (AW) on his reappearance in the spring but it's been downhill in two subsequent starts; hopes pinned on his second visit to Goodwood sparking a revival.
runners.comment: Fairly close fourth in this last year; scored on reappearance but downhill subsequently

runners.name: One Smack Mac
runners.spotlight: A handicapping case can be made on last year's Irish form but he's been slow to get going for this yard and a wide stall is unlikely to help him stage a revival.
runners.comment: A handicapping case can be made but a wide stall is unlikely to help him stage a revival
runners.owner: Emma Banks, David Manasseh & Austin Whelan

runners.name: Morte Point
runners.spotlight: He progressed well over this trip last term and, following a slow start to this season, he was back in the groove in first-time blinkers when scoring at Chester (7f, good to firm) earlier in the month; finished close sixth at York (Pellitory second) under a penalty one week later and he's not readily dismissed.
runners.comment: Won (first-time blinkers) earlier this month; close sixth latest and he can't be ruled out

races.race_name: Racing TV Free Trial British Apprentice Handicap

runners.name: Archduke Ferdinand
runners.spotlight: Conditions to suit and he ran his best race of the year when third over C&D in May; beaten twice since but he is being given a chance by the handicapper.
runners.comment: Conditions to suit and well treated now, 5lb lower than for his C&D third in May; chance

runners.name: Kats Bob
runners.spotlight: Had a fine year in 2025, winning five times; in and out this year but his latest York second (of 19) was a fine run and he needs serious consideration despite a 3lb rise.
runners.comment: Back to form when second of 19 at York 18 days ago; up 3lb but needs serious consideration

runners.name: Artagnan
runners.spotlight: Ran poorly when favourite for a C&D handicap in May; in good form prior to that and a return to form would come as no surprise; high on the list.
runners.comment: Fluffed lines as favourite for a C&D handicap when last seen in May; earlier form solid

runners.name: Amorim
runners.spotlight: Disappointed at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) 33 days ago; earlier Windsor third was a solid effort though and the return of blinkers (worn at Windsor but left off latest) could see him resume his progress.
runners.comment: Low-key run latest but the return of blinkers could give him a lift
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid

runners.name: Star Material
runners.spotlight: Ran his best race of the year when third of eight at Chepstow (6f, good to firm) 26 days ago, his first run after a gelding operation; regular slow starts aren't ideal and the switch to blinkers isn't enough to earn him the vote.
runners.comment: Latest Chepstow third was a better run but more will be needed for the new headgear

runners.name: First Folio
runners.spotlight: Not the force of old but that is reflected in his mark; had wind surgery prior to York 18 days ago, a race in which he ran with more promise than his finishing position suggests; dropped 3lb and the return of headgear can help; better run can be expected.
runners.comment: Down to a low mark; latest run was better than the bare figures; headgear returns; chance

runners.name: Mythical Phoenix
runners.spotlight: Still seeking a first handicap success; huge chance on his 2024 form but he went the wrong way last season and his return to action at Doncaster last month was uninspiring; he has had a wind operation, his second, since but there are risks attached.
runners.comment: Huge chance on 2024 form but still seeking first handicap win and out of sorts for a while

races.race_name: Start Your Racing TV Free Trial Apprentice Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Vanilla Skies
runners.spotlight: Made a winning debut at Newmarket (7f, good to firm; blinkered; 7lb worse off with runner-up Areti today) last month; no match for the odds-on favourite at Salisbury (7f, good to firm) 18 days ago but she finished clear of the third; solid form claims.
runners.comment: A win and a second from her two starts this summer; leading form claims once more

runners.name: Areti
runners.spotlight: Exposed after eight starts but scores good marks for her consistency; back in a maiden after finishing fourth in two 1m handicaps this month (AW/good to firm; latest RPR 77); 7lb better off for her 0.5l defeat by Vanilla Skies at Newmarket in June; obvious chance.
runners.comment: Consistent but not progressive; weighted to reverse Newmarket placings with Vanilla Skies

runners.name: Royale Union
runners.spotlight: Useful pedigree and she made an encouraging start to her career when seventh of 12, beaten under 3l, at Southwell (7f) 24 days ago; open to improvement and could have a big role to play.
runners.comment: Promising seventh on her Southwell debut this month; open to improvement; interesting

runners.name: Ancient Realm
runners.spotlight: Ninth foal; half-sister to winners Hathfa (5f AW; RPR 71) and Yardan (French 7.5f/Qatari 1m); dam unraced half-sister to 6f 2yo Group 1 winner Shalaa; has a fair standard to aim at on debut but worth a market check.
runners.comment: Half-sister to two winners out of an unraced mare from a good family; worth a market check

runners.name: Bowie Lass
runners.spotlight: Sold unraced out of Mick Appleby's stable for 1,000gns last September; bred to be a fair sort but likely best watched on debut.
runners.comment: Fair pedigree but sold unraced last September for 1,000gns; likely best watched

runners.name: Mystic Wave
runners.spotlight: Fourth foal; half-sister to bumper winner Cut The Rope; she would be an unlikely winner on debut.
runners.comment: Half-sister to a bumper winner; unlikely to be winning this first time out

runners.name: Lady Grey
runners.spotlight: Poor form in two sprint novices in the spring; step up in trip needs to give her a big lift.
runners.comment: Poor form in two sprint novices in the spring; step up in trip needs to give her a lift

races.race_name: Stephen And Alan Mulley Apprentice Handicap

runners.name: Kitsune Power
runners.spotlight: Ended a two-year losing run when winning a Class 6 at Beverley (1m2f, good to firm) two weeks ago; steps back up in grade off this 2lb higher mark, but he has to be considered.
runners.comment: Ended a two-year losing run when winning at Beverley last time; up in grade and 2lb higher

runners.name: Harswell Ruby
runners.spotlight: Both wins have been over 1m but she did go close over this C&D last September (good to soft); ran well at Pontefract (1m, good) two starts ago but below her best at Thirsk (good to firm) two weeks ago; steps back up in trip.
runners.comment: Went close over C&D last September; below her best over 1m at Thirsk two weeks ago

runners.name: Leopards Rock
runners.spotlight: Built on his debut when second of 11 in a novice at Newcastle (7f, AW) last month and ran to a similar level when third of six at Carlisle (1m, good to firm) 20 days ago; now makes his handicap debut but his pedigree doesn't suggest he's crying out for this longer trip.
runners.comment: Built on his debut at Newcastle (7f) and ran to similar level latest (1m); handicap debut

runners.name: Lucky Hero
runners.spotlight: Made a winning reappearance in a 7f novice here in April (first start since being gelded) and bounced back from a couple of lesser efforts when a respectable third of six at Ripon (1m2f, good) last time; down in grade and has claims.
runners.comment: Won 7f novice here in April; bounced back from lesser efforts when 3rd at Ripon last time

runners.name: Flying Fletcher
runners.spotlight: All three wins from 36 starts have been on the AW at Newcastle (6f/1m); solid effort when third at Wetherby (1m, good to firm) last month but he needs to bounce back from a lesser effort at Pontefract (1m) three weeks ago; has stamina to prove for this longer trip.
runners.comment: Three-time AW winner (6f/1m); needs to bounce back from a lesser effort at Pontefract

runners.name: Kisiyra
runners.spotlight: Nine-race maiden; ran an encouraging race on her stable debut at Thirsk (1m4f, good) last June but returned from a year off with a heavy defeat at Hamilton (first-time tongue-tie) 55 days ago; drops back in trip and others have stronger claims.
runners.comment: 0-9; returned from a year off with a heavy defeat at Hamilton 55 days ago; back in trip

runners.name: Natzor
runners.spotlight: Dual winner over 1m2f at Newcastle in 2024 but winless since; close-up fourth there at a big price in March but has struggled in three starts since, all at Newcastle; returns to turf with a bit to prove.
runners.comment: Dual winner over 1m2f at Newcastle; struggled on his last three starts; has a bit to prove

runners.name: Optician
runners.spotlight: Off the mark on turf when beating five rivals at Doncaster (1m4f, good to soft) last month but he was beaten 8l when fifth of ten off this mark at York (1m4f, good to firm) 19 days ago; now drops back in trip.
runners.comment: Won at Doncaster (1m4f) last month but well held off this mark at York; back in trip

runners.name: Diderot
runners.spotlight: Four-time AW winner (1m/1m2f) but he's struggled since returning for this stable in January (refused to race on one occasion), albeit he did have a wide trip last time; has dropped to a career-low mark but has a bit to prove.
runners.comment: Four-time AW winner; struggled since returning for this yard in January; bit to prove

races.race_name: Marske Fabrications & Engineering Straight Mile Apprentice Fillies' Handicap (Straight Mile Qual)

runners.name: Sandy Craic
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the ninth attempt when winning at Carlisle (7f, good) last month and ran another good race when bumping into an improver at Beverley (8.5f, good to firm) 25 days ago; considered off the same mark.
runners.comment: Won at Carlisle last month and bumped into an improver at Beverley latest; considered

runners.name: Homestrait
runners.spotlight: Had been placed on her three previous starts before landing a handicap at Carlisle (7f, good to firm) 20 days ago; just 1lb higher here and she looks well worth another try over 1m; contender.
runners.comment: Gained her third success when winning at Carlisle last time; back up to 1m off 1lb higher

runners.name: Only Dream Big
runners.spotlight: Won over 7f here and at Musselburgh (1m, good) in June, the latter coming off a mark 5lb lower than today's; has been held in both starts since and this prominent-racer may be high enough in the weights for now.
runners.comment: Won here over 7f and over 1m at Mussleburgh in June; may be high enough in weights for now

runners.name: Wild Dahlia
runners.spotlight: Quickened up well off a steady pace to win a Chelmsford novice (1m, AW) in October and ran well when runner-up on her handicap debut at Kempton next time; has had wind surgery since and now has a tongue-tie added; contender.
runners.comment: Off since finishing second on handicap debut in October; had wind op and now tongue tied

runners.name: Thornaby Annie
runners.spotlight: Off the mark when winning at Wetherby (1m, good to firm) last month but she disappointed having failed to settle at Nottingham (8.5f, good to firm) next time; bounced back with a good effort at Beverley (7.5f) two weeks ago and makes the shortlist.
runners.comment: Sole win came at Wetherby last month; bounced back from a lesser effort at Beverley latest

runners.name: Borjina
runners.spotlight: Won a Catterick novice over 7f in April; only seventh of ten on her handicap debut at Wetherby (7f, good to firm) next time but she ran well when runner-up at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) 26 days ago; steps up in trip and she should have more to offer after just four starts.
runners.comment: 7f novice winner in April; ran well at Doncaster last time and should have more to offer
runners.owner: All About York And Whatton Manor Stud

runners.name: Kiss Me My Love
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner, the most recent over this C&D in May off a 3lb lower mark; ran well at Doncaster (1m, good to firm) in July but needs to bounce back from a poor run at York (1m) four days ago.
runners.comment: C&D winner in May off 3lb lower; needs to bounce back from a poor recent run at York

races.race_name: Happy Big Birthday Rachel Blizzard Apprentice Handicap

runners.name: South Shore Island
runners.spotlight: Two creditable runs for new connections but he is an exposed 26-race maiden and may have to make do with some more minor money.
runners.comment: Two creditable runs for new yard but he's an exposed 26-race maiden who remains vulnerable

runners.name: Valsharah
runners.spotlight: Exposed 27-race maiden; runner-up in 6f classified events at Brighton on his last two starts (beaten favourite on each occasion); should run his race but others appeal more for win purposes.
runners.comment: Runner-up in 0-50 classified events on his last two starts; record now stands at 0-27

runners.name: Night Emperor
runners.spotlight: Ten-race maiden but he has shown winning potential this summer, notably when doing best of the low-drawn runners at Thirsk (6f, good to firm) on July 1; another solid run (7f) last time; shouldn't be far away.
runners.comment: 0-10 but he's been threatening something bigger this summer; one to consider

runners.name: Due Respect
runners.spotlight: Ran poorly here at the end of May (7f, good to firm) but she otherwise has a good course record; ought to be well treated now but she isn't a solid option.
runners.comment: Plenty of course form to her name but her 2026 campaign has been fairly disappointing

runners.name: Golden Prosperity
runners.spotlight: 5f Catterick win in April; two solid placed efforts this month (5f and 6f, both good to firm); should make another bold bid.
runners.comment: Two solid placed efforts already this month; shouldn't be too far away again

runners.name: Stormy Pearl
runners.spotlight: C&D winner; form dipped at Thirsk four weeks ago but she's the type to bounce back quickly; can get it wrong at the start but she is still more appealing than many.
runners.comment: C&D winner; rare blowout at Thirsk last time but she's the type to bounce back quickly

runners.name: Dolly's Delight
runners.spotlight: Well backed at Thirsk (6f, good to firm) four weeks ago and she ran a fair race in fifth (behind Night Emperor who was poorly drawn); she may prefer a stiffer test at the trip but she is handicapped to go well.
runners.comment: Well backed at Thirsk last time and ran a sound race, albeit held by Night Emperor
runners.owner: The Good Racing Company Ltd & Partner

runners.name: Mrs Trump
runners.spotlight: Two of her five wins have come at Redcar; well handicapped on 2025 best but she's yet to hit top gear this year; others have more pressing claims.
runners.comment: C&D winner; on a good mark but 2026 campaign hasn't got off the ground yet
runners.owner: R Chapman, G J Daly & R J Parks

runners.name: Captain Bentley
runners.spotlight: Sprang an 80-1 shock at Chepstow (5f, good to firm) last July but nothing comparable since, including on last month's return to action.
runners.comment: Little solid form since springing an 80-1 shock at Chepstow 12 months ago

races.race_name: Go Racing In Yorkshire Future Stars Apprentice Handicap

runners.name: Woodleigh
runners.spotlight: Won here over 1m2f in May (good to firm) and followed up in a competitive handicap at Doncaster (1m, good to soft) next time; left the impression he's still in form when fifth there 11 days ago and has to be respected back at this track (2-3 here).
runners.comment: 2-3 here; left the impression he's still in form when fifth at Doncaster latest; respected

runners.name: Tees George
runners.spotlight: Both wins have been over 8.5f at Beverley, the most recent in April off 1lb lower than today; has been running respectably recently and drops back down in grade with solid claims.
runners.comment: Both wins have been over 8.5f at Beverley; has been running respectably; solid claims

runners.name: Elettaria
runners.spotlight: 3-22 on the AW (wins have been at Newcastle over 7f) compared to 1-27 on turf; has been shaping as if she's in form in recent starts and once again has each-way claims.
runners.comment: Best form has been on the AW but has been shaping as if she's in form; each-way chance

runners.name: Mavetheforcebewivu
runners.spotlight: 19-race maiden; beaten 1l when second of eight at Beverley (8.5f, good) last month but she's been well beaten in two starts since, including when failing to beat a rival home there two weeks ago.
runners.comment: 0-19; runner-up at Beverley last month but well beaten in two starts since; best watched

runners.name: Thats My Boy Luke
runners.spotlight: Two wins at Ripon over 1m last year (good/good to firm); respectable fourth of nine at Thirsk (1m, good to firm) in May but he's yet to build on that in four starts since; others look stronger.
runners.comment: Dual winner over 1m at Ripon last year; yet to build on his reappearance this term

runners.name: Pisanello
runners.spotlight: Ended a two-year losing run when winning here over 1m1f on good to firm ten days ago, beating seven rivals; still well treated on his old form under a 4lb penalty and commands respect.
runners.comment: Ended a two-year losing run when winning here over 1m1f ten days ago; carries a penalty

runners.name: Penny Ghent
runners.spotlight: Off the mark when making all at Ripon (1m, good) in May and followed up at Beverley (8.5f, good to firm) next time; faded into eighth of 11 at Doncaster (1m, good to firm) 11 days ago but may get an easier time of things in front this time.
runners.comment: Won at Ripon and Beverley in May; faded last time but may get her own way in front

races.race_name: Tote Guaranteed 50K Placepot Maiden Hurdle

runners.name: De Jour En Jour
runners.spotlight: Placed in five of six starts over hurdles, last three for current yard, notably staying on second in valuable 2m4f auction hurdle final at Punchestown festival, most recently quicker ground and sharp track at Ballinrobe may not have been ideal when third in 2m6f maiden in late May (good); back from a break with cheekpieces tried; strong place claims again.
runners.comment: Multiple-placed maiden; back from a break with cheekpieces on; strong place claims again

runners.name: Frankie's Freebie
runners.spotlight: Point winner has run some solid races in defeat in maiden hurdles behind decent sorts, most recently making most when second over 2m5f at Roscommon early this month (good); should run his race but more needed to play a leading role.
runners.comment: Consistent placed form at around this trip but more needed to play a leading role

runners.name: Jeroboam Machin
runners.spotlight: Won Grade 2 bumper at the DRF in 2024; sidelined until April, pick of two runs in maiden hurdles when hampered early on and weakened late over extended 2m6f in finishing fourth (good); didn't seem to stay 3m at Cork on latest, drops in trip here with headgear combination tried; definite player.
runners.comment: Grade 2 bumper winner yet to show that in maiden hurdles but trip should suit; big player

runners.name: Shoda
runners.spotlight: Two Flat wins include 1m4f maiden at this meeting in 2024 (also second in 2m handicap here last year); 0-6 hurdling however, has had a break since midfield in 2m3f Leopardstown mares handicap in early March; has to be respected from a yard doing no wrong but has to improve on what we've seen so far.
runners.comment: Respected from a yard doing no wrong but has to improve on what we've seen so far hurdling

runners.name: Killowen House
runners.spotlight: Point winner in April ran a cracker on hurdles debut when third in a 3m Cork maiden following month; two runs since over shorter trips not as good, 15l off Frankie's Freebie over 2m5f at Roscommon on latest; bit to find.
runners.comment: 15l off Frankie's Freebie over 2m5f at Roscommon on latest; bit to find

runners.name: Al Arrivee
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to Cheltenham Gold Cup winner Al Boum Photo has won bumpers at Sligo last summer and most recently at Punchestown last month, comfortably landing odds in 2m1f mares' contest (good-to-yielding); also finished second to a smart type at last year's Galway festival; potentially smart recruit to hurdles, major player.
runners.comment: Dual bumper winner second at last year's festival; likely major player on hurdles debut

runners.name: Minella Post
runners.spotlight: Plenty of promise in 2024, in bumpers and maiden hurdles; not near that level of form until recent return from a break in 2m2f Cork maiden in first-time tongue-tie, every chance when taking heavy fall two out; could go well if staying.
runners.comment: Faller at Cork recently when every chance; could go well if staying

runners.name: Dad Sez
runners.spotlight: Flemensfirth gelding cost 70,000euros as a 3yo; brother to 2m7f chase winner Flemen's Tipple; dam 2m-2m3f hurdle/chase winner, sister to French 2m2f Listed hurdle winner Mister Snowball; disputing lead when unseated five out on point-to-point debut at Necarne in May; has since joined Gordon Elliott and market likely good guide on hurdles debut.
runners.comment: Unseated on points' debut in May; has since joined top yard, respected on hurdles debut

runners.name: Mr Hollywood
runners.spotlight: Group 3 winner on the Flat (1m2f, heavy; effective on good); bought for 80,000euros and gelded after winning over 1m4f in France last September; Killarney hurdles debut (2m4f) in May was okay, following month fine third in 2m6f Queen Alexandra Stakes at Ascot on good-to-firm; classy sort should be well up to winning a maiden such as this.
runners.comment: Queen Alexandra third; second attempt hurdling, should be hard to beat if avoiding error

runners.name: C Pas Possible
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to smart staying chaser Lombron; ran okay in a point-to-point and encouraging hurdles debut in 3m Punchestown maiden last month, staying on into third after being short of room going to the last (good-to-yielding); more likely needed but respected.
runners.comment: Encouraging debut third at Punchestown last month; more likely needed but respected

runners.name: I Can Find Em
runners.spotlight: Court Cave gelding; runner-up twice in point-to-points in season just ended, soundly beaten both times; bought for E26,000 since; stable/rules debut.
runners.comment: Runner-up twice in point-to-points; bought for E26,000 since; stable/rules debut

runners.name: Kiltinan
runners.spotlight: Sent off at odds-on for a maiden point at Ballindenisk last November, never threatened when moderate fourth for Andy Slattery; reappears for new yard on hurdles debut.
runners.comment: Beaten odds-on favourite on sole point' for Andy Slattery; best watched on hurdles debut

runners.name: Ol Parson
runners.spotlight: Placed in a point-to-point, two maiden hurdle efforts suggest he's more one for handicaps in due course, although longer trip could suit.
runners.comment: Two maiden hurdle efforts suggest he's more one for handicaps in due course

runners.name: Excessivebehaviour
runners.spotlight: 42,000euros yearling; brother to a useful French 2m-3m hurdle/chase winner, half-brother to five winners; tongue-tied, never sighted on Punchestown maiden debut in November; may need more time but worth a market check.
runners.comment: Never sighted on Punchestown debut; may need more time but worth a market check

runners.name: Trotters Traders
runners.spotlight: Tailed off on recent hurdles debut at Cork, easily passed over.
runners.comment: Ttailed off on recent hurdles debut at Cork, easily passed over

runners.name: Mr Erwitt
runners.spotlight: Very modest form in maidens and pulled up in all three handicaps; hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Very modest form in maidens and pulled up in all three handicaps; hard to fancy

runners.name: Rumi Rock
runners.spotlight: Maiden in point-to-points, well held in Wexford bumper, bit more encouraging in Ballinrobe maiden hurdle eight days ago but unlikely to make the improvement needed here.
runners.comment: Mildly encouraging Ballinrobe debut 8 days ago, unlikely to make the improvement needed

runners.name: Trev The Rev
runners.spotlight: Pulled up after never counting on hurdles debut in Limerick 4yo maiden in March; can only be watched for now.
runners.comment: Pulled up after never counting on hurdles debut at Limerick in March; can only be watched

runners.name: Eternal Reward
runners.spotlight: Mahler 5yo is first foal of a bumper winner, a sister to winners Themanintheboots (2m4f/3m hurdle) and The Brass Man (bumper); never sighted in Fairyhouse bumper last year and place claims when fell at the last in Castletown-Geoghegan point-to-point in October: probably best watched on hurdles debut.
runners.comment: Some points' promise but may need this after a long absence

runners.name: Tom Mac
runners.spotlight: Brother to yard's point/3m hurdle winner Rebel Budz; dam unraced sister to useful 2m/2m1f hurdle winner Hearts Are Trumps, out of unraced sister to Cheltenham Gold Cup winner Denman; never counted on Cork debut back in April, seems best watched on return.
runners.comment: Never counted on Cork debut back in April, seems best watched on return

runners.name: Walkingmayotomilan
runners.spotlight: Reserve; placed in point-to-points for Colin Bowe; never counted (bad early mistake) when tailed off on hurdles debut at Naas in January.
runners.comment: Never counted (bad mistake) when tailed off on hurdles debut at Naas in January; reserve

races.race_name: Tote.ie Money-Back 2nd Every Race Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Imarajan
runners.spotlight: 0-8 on the Flat; an improving hurdler having won at Kilbeggan 19 days ago (2m2f, good) and brings potential into handicaps; unraced over this far.
runners.comment: Recent maiden winner; brings potential into handicaps but unraced over this far

runners.name: Ollie La Ba Ba
runners.spotlight: Won a 2m2f handicap at Listowel in September when 4lb lower; below that level since and this is no easy race in which to bounce back.
runners.comment: Below his winning level on latest runs; this is no easy race in which to bounce back

runners.name: Mavetherave
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; placed in two maidens but very opposable on the balance of his form.
runners.comment: Third reserve; placed in two maidens but very opposable on the balance of his form

runners.name: Harbour Highway
runners.spotlight: 0-5 over hurdles and best form has been over fences, winning in March and twice runner-up since then; poor last time (second run in this headgear combination) but he's an assured stayer at this trip on his return to hurdles.
runners.comment: Has had a good year over fences; poor last time but he's lightly raced over hurdles

runners.name: Cornmarket
runners.spotlight: All three hurdle wins have come at Sligo where he went close 17 days ago (3m1f, good); has something to prove away from that venue but he's not without hope.
runners.comment: All three hurdle wins have come at Sligo where he went close 17 days ago (3m1f, good)
runners.owner: John J Cullen & Michael C Barrett

runners.name: Clonbury Bridge
runners.spotlight: First reserve; six wins split evenly between hurdles and fences; below par of late and a visor replaces the blinkers.
runners.comment: First reserve; below par of late and a visor replaces the blinkers

runners.name: Paul Collins
runners.spotlight: Won a novice handicap here in October but struggled since and latest third was quite remote and in a claimer.
runners.comment: Struggled since last win and latest third was quite remote and in a claimer

runners.name: Therellbguddaysyet
runners.spotlight: Point and maiden hurdle winner; tailed off over hurdles (first-time blinkers) before pulled up in a handicap chase (first-time cheekpieces); others safer.
runners.comment: Maiden hurdle winner; arrives here after poor runs over hurdles and fences

runners.name: Hees Dynamite
runners.spotlight: Won over fences here in October (2m6f) and followed up in a handicap hurdle at Limerick (3m); encouraging return from a break when going close at Killarney 12 days ago and he's in the mix.
runners.comment: Encouraging return from a break when going close at Killarney 12 days ago and in the mix

runners.name: Mephisto
runners.spotlight: Should give his running on the back of respectable shows in 3m/2m6f handicaps but he's stuck on a tough enough mark.
runners.comment: Respectable shows in 3m/2m6f handicaps but he's stuck on a tough enough mark

runners.name: Golden Temple
runners.spotlight: Dual hurdle winner who got off the mark as a chaser five days ago in a 2m4f handicap at Kilbeggan; that was a narrow verdict and he's 5lb higher this afternoon, but he's clearly in good nick.
runners.comment: Dual hurdle winner and successful last week over fences; 5lb higher for this

runners.name: Lord Ffrench
runners.spotlight: Sligo maiden hurdle winner but yet to offer too much in handicaps and has stamina to prove over this far; first-time cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Yet to offer too much in handicaps and has stamina to prove over this far

runners.name: Oneforgonzo
runners.spotlight: Dual hurdles winner at about this trip and won over fences this May; went close off 4lb lower in a Fairyhouse handicap hurdle in January the last time he was ridden by Anna McGuinness.
runners.comment: Went close off 4lb lower in January the last time he was ridden by Anna McGuinness

runners.name: Macshadow Des Crai
runners.spotlight: Placed in French bumpers and again in one of his four runs for Nicky Henderson whom he left for £25,000; has low mileage and Jack Kennedy is booked; could be interesting.
runners.comment: Has low mileage and Jack Kennedy is booked; could be interesting

runners.name: I'll Be Handy
runners.spotlight: Modest on the Flat; well beaten on handicap debut over hurdles in May but had some useful juvenile form and wouldn't be without hope should this new headgear combination trigger a return to that level.
runners.comment: Useful juvenile hurdle form and possible if back to that level in new headgear combination

runners.name: Tangara Bay
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced for Henry De Bromhead but she signed off for that yard with a maiden win (2m3f, soft; sold on for £10,000); could have more to offer for new yard but lacks a recent run and may prefer softer ground.
runners.comment: Maiden winner in a new yard; lacks a recent run and may prefer softer ground
runners.owner: Mickey D's Bus Tangara Five Syndicate

runners.name: Andys Flame
runners.spotlight: Hurdle/chase winner; didn't look an easy ride when beaten about 10l off this mark at Kilbeggan five days ago.
runners.comment: Didn't look an easy ride when beaten about 10l off this mark at Kilbeggan five days ago

runners.name: Mighty Berkshire
runners.spotlight: Positively ridden when fourth in a 2m3f maiden at Kilbeggan latest; lightly raced 6yo contesting only his second handicap and has new headgear; not entirely dismissed.
runners.comment: Lightly raced 6yo contesting only his second handicap and has new headgear

runners.name: Coded Welder
runners.spotlight: Case can be made off this mark on best of his form and has run quite well in a pair of 2m3f handicaps for current yard; possibilities back up to a trip that he does stay.
runners.comment: Has run quite well in a pair of 2m3f handicaps for current yard; stays this far

runners.name: Priory Park
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; an exposed 10yo who needs to leave his most recent efforts behind.
runners.comment: Second reserve; an exposed 10yo who needs to leave his most recent efforts behind

runners.name: Lucy Wang
runners.spotlight: Dual point winner who was third in a hunter chase last time; doesn't have the obvious profile for this race but she showed useful form in 2023 when runner-up in a Leopardstown maiden and she needs checking in the betting on debut for Emmet Mullins.
runners.comment: Not an obvious profile for this but needs checking in betting on debut for Emmet Mullins

runners.name: Granville Street
runners.spotlight: Sole Flat success came in a 1m4f handicap at this meeting three years ago and later that year he won a maiden hurdle; no joy since though and was struggling when last seen over hurdles.
runners.comment: No joy since 2023 and was struggling when last seen over hurdles

runners.name: Camino Rock
runners.spotlight: Modest strike-rate and was in no form when last seen during the winter; hard to recommend.
runners.comment: Modest strike-rate and was in no form when last seen during the winter; hard to recommend

races.race_name: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Irish EBF Mares Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Samba Train
runners.spotlight: Dual bumper winner who beat 15 rivals in a Killarney maiden in May (2m6f); quick enough for this sharper test and dangerously unexposed now handicapping.
runners.comment: 2m6f winner last time but quick enough to win two bumpers; handicap debut

runners.name: Astelia
runners.spotlight: Stable won this in 2022 and 2023; this mare is 0-9 over hurdles but has finished runner-up seven times, including her sole handicap start two outings ago; looks handicapped about right but has each-way claims.
runners.comment: Handicapped about right but has each-way claims given her consistency

runners.name: You Make Me Smile
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; course winner on the Flat and went close on final jumps run at Downpatrick last month; not without hope if getting a run.
runners.comment: Third reserve; course winner on the Flat and went close on final jumps run
runners.owner: T & R Hennessy & A Fahy Partnership

runners.name: Ardeen Joy
runners.spotlight: It wasn't a strong maiden she won at Bellewstown (2m4f, good) but merits respect all the same as a handicap debutante from a top yard.
runners.comment: It wasn't a strong maiden she won at Bellewstown (2m4f) but merits respect all the same

runners.name: Hillhead Runner
runners.spotlight: Useful form for previous yards; still early days with Charles Byrnes and perhaps went off too fast in maiden company at Kilbeggan (2m2f, good; favourite); often leads and dominating a field of this size won't be easy.
runners.comment: Has some useful form but often leads and dominating a field of this size won't be easy

runners.name: She's A Fine Wine
runners.spotlight: Had 50 days off before winning over fences in October and returning from 245 days away when narrowly following up in a handicap hurdle at Downpatrick (2m3f, good; 6lb lower); a likeable type who should give this a good shot.
runners.comment: Multiple winner who goes well fresh; a likeable type who should give this a good shot

runners.name: Venusienne
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced mare who was initially highly tried by Willie Mullins; hooded when making the most of a huge drop in class at Tramore (2m4f maiden) but ran miserably when odds-on at Kilbeggan; not easy to assess ahead of this handicap debut.
runners.comment: One standout run for Willie Mullins; not easily assessed ahead of handicap debut

runners.name: Sea Of Doubt
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in this 12 months ago; looks in better form now, winning at Downpatrick in May and solid since then (including over fences two runs ago); no match for Small Bucks last time but she's 7lb better off with that rival; unseated rider at first fence 5.45 on Tuesday.
runners.comment: Well beaten in this 12 months ago; unseated here Tuesday

runners.name: Tingarran Express
