runners.spotlight: Second reserve; well beaten on chase debut latest; 3-37 over hurdles so she's not prolific; others preferred.
runners.comment: Second reserve; well beaten on chase debut latest; 3-37 over hurdles so she's not prolific

runners.name: Two Pair
runners.spotlight: Bellewstown maiden hurdle winner in April and following handicap run at Wexford looked too bad to be true; still lightly raced.
runners.comment: Won a maiden in April and following handicap run at Wexford looked too bad to be true

runners.name: Missus Beeton
runners.spotlight: Competitive form in 2024 and missed the following year; won two soft-ground handicaps for new yard earlier this year but she's fine on good and latest run at Bellewstown was after three months off; now visored.
runners.comment: Capable handicapper; latest run at Bellewstown was after three months off; now visored

runners.name: Billie Frechette
runners.spotlight: Finished well to finish second in this 12 months ago when only 1lb lower; could be glad to see the back of fences (0-3) and one to consider.
runners.comment: Chasing of late; finished well to finish second in this 12 months ago when only 1lb lower

runners.name: Cleopatra's Needle
runners.spotlight: Fit off the Flat and she was quite a convincing winner of this 12 months ago off 7lb lower; raced only once over hurdles in the meantime.
runners.comment: Fit off the Flat and she was quite a convincing winner of this 12 months ago off 7lb lower

runners.name: Small Bucks
runners.spotlight: Comfortably saw off Sea Of Doubt at Downpatrick two weeks ago (2m2f, good) but she went up 8lb for that and doesn't always follow one good run with another.
runners.comment: Easy winner 15 days ago but up 8lb and doesn't always follow one good run with another

runners.name: Emesteraye
runners.spotlight: First reserve; 0-5; placed in her first handicap at Wexford but fared less well at Limerick; perhaps the tongue-tie will help.
runners.comment: First reserve; 0-5; placed in first handicap at Wexford but fared less well at Limerick

runners.name: Crohan Lady
runners.spotlight: Point/maiden hurdle winner who ran surprisingly well on unfavourable terms at Clonmel last time (2m3f); unwise to take that form at face value.
runners.comment: Point/maiden hurdle winner who ran surprisingly well on unfavourable terms at Clonmel

runners.name: Bossy Bird
runners.spotlight: Progressing and might have won on her handicap debut at Cork but for some interference (2m4f, good); this drop in distance isn't an obvious positive but one to bear in mind.
runners.comment: Progressing and might have won on her handicap debut at Cork but for some interference

runners.name: Splashing Out
runners.spotlight: Had lost her way but firmly back on track now and won comfortably at Tramore; back up 6lb in a deeper race but considered.
runners.comment: Won comfortably at Tramore; back up 6lb in a deeper race but considered

runners.name: Zahra Dodville
runners.spotlight: Ex-French; Fakenham winner on yard debut and even better since then, finishing third in a Listed hurdle before a near miss at Cartmel (2m1f, good; handicap debut); interesting runner for a British yard going great runs; first-time cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Second on handicap debut latest; interesting runner for a British yard going great runs

runners.name: Fratas
runners.spotlight: Had flashes of good form under both codes for previous yard, whom she left after finishing tailed off in this 12 months ago (went off too fast); lurks on a reasonable mark on just her second run for Joseph O'Brien; finished last in the first (1m maiden) but that was after a long break so could strip fitter now.
runners.comment: Won plenty for previous yard; could strip fitter for recent stable debut on the Flat

runners.name: Simple Things
runners.spotlight: Only fifth when favourite last time but perhaps the ground was too soft having previously finished second in 2m1f/2m4f handicaps on quicker surfaces; after seven races there's scope for further improvement.
runners.comment: Twice second before perhaps softer ground found her out last time; only ran seven times

runners.name: Camlin Park
runners.spotlight: 1-6 in points; Downpatrick maiden hurdle winner but twice pulled up since then, latterly on handicap debut in April.
runners.comment: 1-6 in points; Downpatrick maiden hurdle winner but twice pulled up since then

runners.name: Wonderfulwonderful
runners.spotlight: Just three runs over hurdles and won a Killarney maiden by 10l last August; made all in a 1m1f maiden last month when tried in first-time cheekpieces; could have a part to play.
runners.comment: Maiden hurdle winner who added a Flat maiden last month; not exposed just yet

races.race_name: Tote Galway Plate (Handicap Chase) (Grade 3)

runners.name: Downmexicoway
runners.spotlight: Absent for 141 days but returns with his yard in great form; only had five runs over fences, winning twice and better than ever when a 10l fourth in the 2m4f Plate at the Cheltenham Festival; that form can be upgraded as he was hampered on a couple of occasions and has a useful pull in the weights with runner-up Will The Wise; yet to tackle this far under rules but he won a 3m point; tempting.
runners.comment: Unexposed; fourth in the Plate at Cheltenham in March despite a troubled run

runners.name: Nowwhatdoyouthink
runners.spotlight: Point, bumper and maiden hurdle winner; record of 2-8 over fences and signed off for previous yard on a high, winning a small-field Grade 3 before outrunning his odds behind last year's Galway Plate hero Western Fold in a 3m1f Grade 1 novice chase at Punchestown in April; intriguing runner now with Gordon Elliott, who has won this five times.
runners.comment: Significant improvement this spring, latterly third in a Grade 1; now with Gordon Elliott

runners.name: Three Card Brag
runners.spotlight: For one who stays much further he ran surprisingly well when splitting Senecia and Jess Evans in a 2m4f Grade 3 at Killarney last time, which was his first run over that sort of trip since 2023; he knows what these big-field handicaps are all about and could run well at lengthy odds with a 7lb claimer easing his burden.
runners.comment: Stays further but 2nd last time at about 2m4f; knows that these big fields are all about

runners.name: Nouvotic
runners.spotlight: Progressive chaser but went up 10lb for winning a 2m4f Grade 3 in April and he came up short back in a handicap at Wexford, though still ran well and probably found the 2m3f trip sharp enough; each-way possibilities, though regular partner Darragh O'Keeffe has deserted him this time.
runners.comment: Might be high in the weights after coming up short off 1lb lower last time

runners.name: Boston Rover
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; completed a hat-trick over fences in October (2m4f; 8lb lower) but backward steps have followed, latterly finishing behind some of these at Kilbeggan.
runners.comment: Second reserve; finished behind some of these last time at Kilbeggan and can be taken on

runners.name: King Of Kingsfield
runners.spotlight: One-time smart hurdler; three chase wins in the space of four runs last year included a beginners chase at this meeting and a 2m2f Grade 3 at Punchestown; hasn't kicked on at all from that sequence and he'd be a surprise winner.
runners.comment: Hasn't kicked on at all from last October's Grade 3 win; he'd be a surprise winner

runners.name: Barry Lyndon
runners.spotlight: Useful three-time winner over hurdles; didn't look that progressive as a chaser until comfortably beating 20 rivals in a 3m Listed handicap at Punchestown in May; a 6lb rise could have been worse and he's now 2-3 under J J Slevin; couldn't put a line through him.
runners.comment: Impressed in winning a big-field handicap last time and a 6lb rise could have been worse

runners.name: King Alexander
runners.spotlight: 4-13 over hurdles and 1-5 as a chaser; unlikely that he gave his true running when a beaten favourite behind Nouvotic last time and his previous fourth over 2m4f at the Cheltenham Festival raises optimism; Townend has turned elsewhere, however.
runners.comment: His 4th at Cheltenham raises optimism but disappointing since; neglected by Townend

runners.name: Jalila Moriviere
runners.spotlight: First reserve; only chase win came at the expense of modest opposition; finished a clear second at Punchestown last time (2m4f) but appeared to get outstayed and has further to go this time.
runners.comment: First reserve; appeared to get outstayed over 2m4f last time and has further to go here

runners.name: Maxxum
runners.spotlight: A better hurdler than chaser but rated accordingly; however, he was a disappointing favourite in the Mayo National when last seen two months ago; others are more intriguing.
runners.comment: Disappointing favourite in the Mayo National when last seen two months ago

runners.name: Funiculi Funicula
runners.spotlight: Grade 1-placed over hurdles and already a better chaser, making it 2-4 in this discipline when a well-backed 3l winner of a strong 2m4f novice handicap at Punchestown in May (2m4f, yielding); took an 8lb hit for that but the ceiling of his ability is not yet established and he should stay this far; Townend's pick of the Mullins runners.
runners.comment: An improving chaser who impressed last time off 8lb lower; should stay this far

runners.name: Rocky's Diamond
runners.spotlight: Fourth in last year's Stayers' Hurdle at Cheltenham; successful chase debut over 2m2f here last September and two good runs in defeat afterwards, including a Grade 2; after two runs over hurdles he returned to fences in a handicap at Roscommon and excuses came to light afterwards; too talented to dismiss.
runners.comment: Classy staying hurdler; course winner over fences; had excuses last time

runners.name: Reverend Hubert
runners.spotlight: 2-4 over fences, though not seen in this discipline since well held in a Grade 3 at this fixture two years ago; he returns in excellent form, in recent weeks winning on the Flat (2m) and over hurdles at Cork (3m); could have a big run in him.
runners.comment: Not seen over fences (2-4) since this meeting in 2024; recent Flat/hurdle winner

runners.name: Ballygunner Castle
runners.spotlight: The winner of two bumpers and a maiden hurdle; this is a big ask for a maiden over fences (0-4) but his seconds read well (pushed Spread Boss Ted close in one of those) and he looked in need of further than 2m4f when behind that rival and Funiculi Funicula on his handicap debut at Punchestown; could deliver the career best this race demands.
runners.comment: Promising in defeat over fences; could deliver the career best this race demands

runners.name: Gorgeous Tom
runners.spotlight: Lacks course form over fences; smart novice who ran creditably in two strong handicaps (3m2f/2m5f) last season before finishing tailed off in the Grand National at Aintree where not a lot went right (twice badly hampered; 20-1); enters the reckoning.
runners.comment: Smart novice who ran creditably in strong handicaps last season; Aintree didn't go to plan

runners.name: Will The Wise
runners.spotlight: Course winner; off for 110 days but proven when fresh; last season ended on a high with his second to a handicap snip in the Plate at Cheltenham in March (2m4f) and then going one better when reversing those placings in the Topham at Aintree (2m5f); straightforward and a good jumper who should be well suited by the demands of this race; player.
runners.comment: Major progress last season in hot handicaps; jumps well and looks a big player

runners.name: Perceval Legallois
runners.spotlight: Some inconsistency has crept in but off a reduced mark and running in just the tongue-tie, he returned to form with a second of 14 behind Solitary Man in the Midlands National at Kilbeggan (3m1f, good); whether he'll repeat that remains to be seen and he probably appreciates further than 2m6f these days.
runners.comment: Back to form last time but over 3m1f and that's probably more his trip these days

runners.name: Solitary Man
runners.spotlight: Won a hunter chase in May and last time returned to his best when emerging from off a strong pace to beat Perceval Legallois in the 3m1f Midlands National at Kilbeggan; ideally wants further than this but a solid pace would help in that respect; back up 7lb.
runners.comment: Recent Kilbeggan Midlands National winner over 3m1f; back in trip and up 7lb
runners.owner: Shanahan/Mrs M V Magnier/Mrs Carthy/Mrs Bartlett

runners.name: Jesse Evans
runners.spotlight: Course winner; this meeting owes him one having twice finished runner-up in the Galway Hurdle (and fourth) and second in this last year behind Western Fold; returns off a 2lb lower mark despite beating notable opposition at Listowel on final run; solid chance.
runners.comment: Several good runs at this meeting include his second in this race 12 months ago

runners.name: Ballybawn Belter
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; won a 2m4f Limerick Listed handicap at Christmas and respectable since then, though her latest third at Fairyhouse was quite remote; her course form ticks a box but others are less exposed in this discipline.
runners.comment: Third reserve; her course form ticks a box but others are less exposed in this discipline

runners.name: Conyers Hill
runners.spotlight: Career best form when fourth in the Paddy Power Gold Cup at Cheltenham in November (2m4f, soft); back from a break with two seconds, though was no match for the winner on either occasion (including Nouvotic); travels well but doesn't always find much for pressure.
runners.comment: Career best needed; travels well but doesn't always find much for pressure

runners.name: Spread Boss Ted
runners.spotlight: Dual hurdle winner; beat Ballygunner Castle to get off the mark as a chaser at Naas and for one so inexperienced he did well to finish a 6l third behind Funiculi Funicula in a 22-runner handicap at Punchestown in May (2m4f, yielding); has low mileage for a 9yo and there could be more to come; finished second in a bumper on one previous visit to Galway.
runners.comment: Only fourth run over fences when third to Funiculi Funicula at Punchestown in May

runners.name: Senecia
runners.spotlight: Rated this high for a reason and was never headed when beating Three Card Brag in a Grade 3 at Killarney when last seen in May; however, he'll do well to repeat those tactics in this race and he was well beaten last year (held up).
runners.comment: Made all in a Grade 3 last time; he'll do well to repeat those tactics in this race

runners.name: Ol Man Dingle
runners.spotlight: Beat Will The Wise on his chase debut here last October and followed up in a Grade 3; appeared stretched by nearly 3m in the Mayo National before a determined victory back over 2m4f at Kilbeggan (cheekpieces returned); this intermediate trip might be just the ticket.
runners.comment: Course winner who is 3-7 over fences;  this intermediate trip might be just the ticket

runners.name: Buddy One
runners.spotlight: Smart staying hurdler/chaser who made a mistake at the wrong time when beaten about 18l in this 12 months ago when 5lb higher; failed to threaten afterwards in both disciplines, and again in a recent run on the Flat; others appeal more.
runners.comment: Admirably versatile; made a mistake in this 12 months ago; others still preferred
runners.owner: E Lynch & T C Quinn & John J McGrath

races.race_name: Visit Tote26 On Course Today (Q.R.) Maiden

runners.name: Mergus Serrator
runners.spotlight: Holds quite a lofty rating, unable to justify it on last month's handicap debut at Down Royal when left with plenty to do in Ulster Derby; previous maiden runs over shorter were solid efforts; stamina now proven and should go well under more positive ride.
runners.comment: Left with plenty to do in Ulster Derby; stamina now proven, should go well back in maiden

runners.name: Daddy Long Legs
runners.spotlight: 149-rated hurdler, gaining fifth hurdle success at Ballinrobe in May; beaten by the unconsidered Counting Coup in a Flat maiden at Down Royal before odds-on defeat over hurdles at Limerick; didn't get into valuable amateur handicap here on Monday, potentially big player in maiden company here.
runners.comment: Classy hurdler is 0-3 on the Flat; potentially big player nonetheless

runners.name: Kimy
runners.spotlight: Poor strike rate hurdling (1-25) and pick of three recent runs on the Flat when staying on late into second in 1m4f Tramore maiden (found to have in blood in both nostrils); interesting but this is a stronger maiden.
runners.comment: Recent Tramore second was encouraging but this is a stronger maiden

runners.name: Sunny South West
runners.spotlight: Dual bumper winner and maiden hurdle winner; fine comeback run and Flat debut when second at Killarney (1m6f, good) earlier this month and top amateur rider remains loyal.
runners.comment: Fine comeback run at Killarney recently; top amateur rider remains loyal

runners.name: Abbotsford
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced son of Frankel has been gelded since finishing second to an odds-on shot in 1m2f Cork maiden in May, having run green; one-time Irish Derby entry could well have more to offer from a yard with such a fine Galway record.
runners.comment: Gelded since Cork second in May; well-bred and likely has more to offer

runners.name: Will You Stop
runners.spotlight: Decent efforts last two maiden runs at 1m2f, every chance when third at Gowran and again positively-ridden when fourth behind a smart type at the Curragh; not certain to stay this longer trip but a player if he does.
runners.comment: Placings at 1m2f would put him in the mix if staying this longer trip

runners.name: New Bay Star
runners.spotlight: Placed on four of six attempts for Charlie Johnston in Britain, including all three starts on AW last winter when wearing cheekpieces; bought for 45,000gns in February and debuts for new yard with Harry Swan booked.
runners.comment: AW placings last winter for Charlie Johnston; cost 45,000gns; debuts for new yard

runners.name: Hopes Are High
runners.spotlight: Took well to hurdles, winning at Ballinrobe and Listowel last year before good second at Punchestown in October; fair Flat form over shorter trips than today's so stamina concerns on comeback run.
runners.comment: Better hurdler; absent since October and stamina concerns

runners.name: Nakassama
runners.spotlight: Has done well over hurdles this year, winning 2m6f Downpatrick handicap last month and good second off revised mark since at Cartmel and Downpatrick; first start on the Flat since finishing second in this race last year and could go well again.
runners.comment: Last year's second in great form hurdling of late so has to be respected

runners.name: Coolnagrattan
runners.spotlight: Promise on debut in Punchestown bumper last month and again later in month (well backed) in 1m4f Roscommon Flat maiden, staying on third after not clear run; likely has more to offer.
runners.comment: Well-backed staying on Roscommon third (not clear run); likely has more to offer

runners.name: Can Happen
runners.spotlight: Off the mark over hurdles in Ballinrobe handicap (2m, good) on debut for this yard in late May and good Flat debut when strong-finishing second to an odds-on shot in Bellewstown amateur riders' event over this trip early this month under today's rider; this a tougher task but respected.
runners.comment: Bellewstown second faces a stiffer task but respected
runners.owner: Michael J Mulligan & Patrick G Walsh

runners.name: Home By The Sea
runners.spotlight: Ran once in a bumper and 0-4 hurdling, pick being fourth in a Roscommon maiden on good ground, last of 15 on latest in Killarney handicap; seems an unlikely one to make an impact on Flat debut.
runners.comment: 0-4 hurdling, unlikely one to make an impact on Flat

runners.name: Run For Mahler
runners.spotlight: Hurdle rating went up to a career-high 132 after winning 2m5f Killarney mares event 13 days ago, needing every yard to get up close home (good); one to consider on Flat debut.
runners.comment: Recent Killarney hurdles winner one to consider now on Flat debut

runners.name: Chairmanforlife
runners.spotlight: Improvement on second maiden start to finish fourth over 1m5f at Ballinrobe in May, withdrawn on account of quick ground at Leopardstown since; noteworthy jockey booking and yard in fine form.
runners.comment: Ballinrobe fourth was promising; noteworthy jockey booking and yard in fine form

runners.name: Glowing Account
runners.spotlight: Smart Flat pedigree; looked good when justifying prohibitive odds on debut in Listowel bumper in September 2023 (good) but was unable to build on that twice afterwards on softer ground; absent since December 2023 and makes hurdles debut with ground likely to suit and clearly goes well fresh.
runners.comment: Listowel bumper winner in 2023; long absent but ground to suit on hurdles debut

runners.name: Eyeeye
runners.spotlight: Long-standing maiden in both codes; hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Long-standing maiden in both codes; hard to fancy

runners.name: Four Ball
runners.spotlight: Third reserve;  half-brother to 1m2f winner Heiselectric (RPR 89); dam unraced half-sister to decent dual-purpose performers Zoffman and Sheishybrid; 66-1, some late headway into midfield on last month's Fairyhouse debut over this trip; tongue-tie now fitted, improvement likely.
runners.comment: Mildly encouraging Fairyhouse debut; tongue-tie now fitted, improvement likely; reserve

runners.name: Galileo Springs
runners.spotlight: First reserve; fair hurdler, winning Killarney mares maiden last October (yielding), most recently didn't count on Flat debut in 1m2f Roscommon maiden in May; lots more needed.
runners.comment: Hurdles winner needs to improve markedly on recent Flat debut; reserve

runners.name: Believe Again
runners.spotlight: Tailed off in a Listowel bumper last September and in rear on Flat debut at Roscommon in May; can be ruled out.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten on Flat debut at Roscommon in May; easily passed over

runners.name: It's Good To Talk
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; runner-up in Naas bumper on heavy, two runs in Flat maidens however leave him with lots to find.
runners.comment: Runner-up in Naas bumper but two runs in Flat maidens leave him with lots to find; reserve

runners.name: Silas Marner
runners.spotlight: Dual-purpose maiden for Charles O'Brien rated a meagre 54 on the Flat; hard to fancy on yard debut.
runners.comment: Dual-purpose maiden for Charles O'Brien rated 54 on the Flat; hard to fancy on yard debut

races.race_name: Tote Every Day Is A Money-Back Day Handicap

runners.name: Krasimir
runners.spotlight: Several placings before off the mark in Dundalk AW maiden over this trip earlier in the month under a positive ride, not needing to improve on previous turf efforts which included Leopardstown third (beaten 1l) to Johnny Soda whom he now meets on 8lb better terms; contender from a good draw.
runners.comment: AW maiden winner meets Johnny Soda on 8lb better terms for 1l Leopardstown defeat

runners.name: Monvoe
runners.spotlight: Progressive handicapper with wins this term at Limerick, Leopardstown and most recently at former venue last month, despite hanging right; later in month didn't count in Curragh premier handicap but claims back in grade here.
runners.comment: Progressive handicapper back down in grade here so respected

runners.name: Golddream
runners.spotlight: Dundalk AW maiden winner at this trip in April; behind Johnny Soda last two starts, most recently beaten 3l in Killarney handicap when never on terms over 1m; bit to find but stiffer track could suit.
runners.comment: Bit to find with Johnny Soda on Killarney form but stiffer track could suit

runners.name: Mayflower
runners.spotlight: Debut juvenile winner a year ago (7f, Leopardstown); opened 3yo campaign in Group 3 company, notably 3.5l off subsequent US Grade 1 winner Kensingston Lane in Athasi Stakes (Curragh); never really landed a blow on handicap debut at same venue in late May (1m), cheekpieces tried.
runners.comment: Highly-tried; never landed a blow on handicap debut (1m) and cheekpieces added now

runners.name: Monoceros
runners.spotlight: Newmarket debut winner for Charlie Appleby last summer (7f, good-to-firm); creditable yard debut in Musselburgh handicap in April but has taken a backward step both starts since.
runners.comment: British challenger; improvement needed on recent efforts

runners.name: Johnny Soda
runners.spotlight: Enjoying a fine season with 1m wins in handicap at Cork, rated race at Leopardstown (Krasimir third) and most recently in Killarney handicap 16 days ago, defying top-weight narrowly; 5lb rise for latest but should remain competitive.
runners.comment: Three wins already this season; 5lb rise for recent Killarney success okay

runners.name: Moonlit Sun
runners.spotlight: Had a run in a barrier trial last year; shaped promisingly when third behind the smart Sparan Nua in Naas maiden (1m) in May and following month landed similar contest, despite running green, good chance she'll improve again on handicap debut although opening mark looks high enough.
runners.comment: Still green when winning Naas maiden over this trip; more likely on handicap debut

runners.name: Minella Rockett
runners.spotlight: Placed in Dundalk AW maidens last winter, not so good there in May before successful hurdling debut in Limerick 3yo maiden early this month, despite taking keen hold and making most (good); didn't get home over 1m2f on sole Flat handicap effort (Navan) before that win so drop back in trip should suit.
runners.comment: Recent hurdles winner will appreciate drop back in trip on second Flat handicap attempt

runners.name: God Of Power
runners.spotlight: Limerick maiden winner went up 8lb after finishing second to an older rival in Listowel conditions event; ran to similar level when fourth in rated race at Leopardstown, weakening close home; prominent racer but wide draw and stiff finish possible negatives.
runners.comment: Holding his form well but wide draw and stiff finish likely negatives for prominent racer

runners.name: Time Bender
runners.spotlight: Sprang a 33-1 surprise in a Leopardstown maiden this time last year (7f, good) but hasn't built on that effort, most recently seasonal return at same venue early this month (hanging left late on); entitled to come on for that.
runners.comment: Needs to improve a fair bit on recent Leopardstown comeback run

runners.name: Loch Gamhna
runners.spotlight: Maiden hasn't lived up to a quite lofty rating achieved on the back of Curragh maiden third last autumn (soft-to-heavy), although wasn't disgraced in Gowran conditions event in June; looks to have it to do off this mark.
runners.comment: Best form came at 2 on testing ground; has it to do off this mark on handicap bow

runners.name: Kirkland Sioux
runners.spotlight: Progressive filly on a hat-trick of handicap wins, after successes over this trip at Fairyhouse and when defying 12lb rise at the Curragh, making all in beating her elders; up a further 11lb here but still greatly respected.
runners.comment: Hat-trick seeking filly up 23lb in total; respected nonetheless

runners.name: Amenita
runners.spotlight: Kingman filly didn't show much in sole start last season at Cork (7f, soft) when slowly away, but reappeared to land Gowran fillies' maiden last month, wearing down a front-runner late on over 1m (yielding) - third has won since; unexposed entering handicap ranks and booking of in-form claimer a positive.
runners.comment: Gowran maiden likely more to offer on handicap bow; in-form claimer booked

races.race_name: Bet With Tote.ie On Racing & Sports Handicap

runners.name: Slurricane
runners.spotlight: Useful hurdler who has won twice on the Flat, including here over 1m4f last October off 75; creditable effort at Gowran earlier in season but improvement needed on recent Limerick run.
runners.comment: 1m4f winner here in October but something to find on recent efforts

runners.name: Duke Of Leggagh
runners.spotlight: Dangerous when gets his favoured soft conditions, as when bolting up at Bellewstown in October; recent Ballinrobe comeback run should have brought him on but won't get his preferred ground here and terrible draw to overcome.
runners.comment: Better for recent comeback run but won't get his preferred soft ground and terrible draw

runners.name: Sign From Above
runners.spotlight: Three wins on the Flat include here over 1m6f three years ago; below best under both codes of late, fair bit to find with Gaoth Chuil on recent Killarney effort.
runners.comment: Below best under both codes, fair bit to find with Gaoth Chuil on recent Killarney run

runners.name: Sanctity Of Space
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced mare; good efforts in final two maidens for Joseph O'Brien in October 2024; soon beaten on return from long absence in 1m6f Fairyhouse handicap last June but entitled to come on for that and usual cheekpieces back on here.
runners.comment: Maiden promise in 2024; entitled to come on for recent comeback run with cheekpieces on

runners.name: Black Heather
runners.spotlight: Bumper and maiden hurdle winner for Harry Kelly; recent flat maiden efforts have been creditable but not sure if they justify this initial handicap mark and poorly drawn.
runners.comment: NH mare; flat maiden efforts creditable but not sure if they justify this mark

runners.name: Not Just Any Eagle
runners.spotlight: Four Flat wins at up to 1m4f, including Leopardstown handicap last season off 78; recent Fairyhouse third over 1m6f encouraging in terms of stamina; don't rule out.
runners.comment: Rallying Fairyhouse third suggests he may get this extended trip; don't rule out

runners.name: Louiescall
runners.spotlight: Won over just shy of this trip at Leopardstown last summer off 69; mainly campaigned over hurdles since; Killarney comeback run was over an inadequate trip so more expected here although cruel draw.
runners.comment: Comeback run was over an inadequate trip so more expected here although cruel draw

runners.name: Boxing Great
runners.spotlight: Dundalk AW winner last winter has run okay in some competitive handicaps in Britain, most recently at Newcastle last month; down in class and each-way claims.
runners.comment: Has run okay in some competitive handicaps in Britain; down in class and each-way claims

runners.name: Wackestone
runners.spotlight: Twice placed in juvenile hurdles but hasn't progressed, well below best in Bellewstown maiden latest; good run when last seen on the flat in Navan maiden (1m2f, soft) in April 2025 but questions to answer here in terms of trip on handicap debut.
runners.comment: Out of form hurdling of late; questions to answer here in terms of trip on handicap debut

runners.name: Cock And Bull
runners.spotlight: Three flat wins for Michael Bell came at 1m6f on quick ground; ordinary enough hurdles form for current yard but fine run on the flat over this trip at the Curragh on Derby weekend back on decent ground, only losing second late on when 2lb out of handicap; down in grade here and tongue-tie tried; has to be respected.
runners.comment: Curragh third at this trip; down in grade here and tongue-tie tried; has to be respected
runners.owner: Sarah Dale & Wayne Dale & Ian Foster

runners.name: Liam Swagger
runners.spotlight: Useful juvenile hurdler for James Owen in 2024-25 season; AW winner last year but never sighted on last month's flat return at Roscommon; visor replaces cheekpieces and bad draw so of limited appeal.
runners.comment: Never sighted on last month's flat return; visor replaces cheekpieces and bad draw

runners.name: Papagei
runners.spotlight: Twice a winner in Britain for James Ferguson at 1m4f; kept to hurdling so far by current trainer, just okay form; first try at this extended trip, okay mark.
runners.comment: British wins at 1m4f; back from hurdling and unproven over this far

runners.name: Wahraan
runners.spotlight: Three flat wins for various trainers in Britain and off the mark over hurdles for current trainer in 2m3f Market Rasen maiden in late May (good); had earlier not looked a straightforward ride on occasions; has had a break since.
runners.comment: Had a break since hurdles win in May; not the most straightforward on occasions

runners.name: Rakki
runners.spotlight: Fairly useful hurdler last season, winning Roscommon maiden; well held in handicaps however, latest at same venue last month; standout flat run for Alan King when touched off in 1m6f Sandown handicap two years ago (Cock And Bull third); noteworthy jockey booking for flat return.
runners.comment: Well held in handicap hurdles of late; noteworthy jockey booking for flat return

runners.name: Ephesus
runners.spotlight: Both flat wins have been at 1m4f, including Roscommon handicap last autumn off 73 (soft); reappeared last month, well held in both attempts over fences; opposable.
runners.comment: Reappeared last month, well held in both attempts over fences; opposable

runners.name: Forlio
runners.spotlight: Was gaining a third career win when scoring over 1m4f at Tramore early this month, winning convincingly under a hold-up ride; hit with 11lb hike takes him to a career-high but in-form claimer takes off 7lb.
runners.comment: Tramore winner hit with 11lb hike but in-form claimer takes off 7lb

runners.name: Gaoth Chuil
runners.spotlight: Very useful hurdler has come good on the flat of late on decent ground, winning Leopardstown maiden and following up in 2m1f Killarney handicap when allowed to dictate matters; up 7lb for that but can still go well.
runners.comment: Hat-trick seeker up 7lb for Killarney but can go well again

runners.name: Eastmore
runners.spotlight: First reserve; consistent form in handicap hurdles of late rewarded by 2m Limerick success early this month (good); limited opportunities on the flat, placed in three turf maidens back in 2023, well held in AW handicap following year.
runners.comment: Recent hurdles winner still unexposed on the flat; reserve

runners.name: Harry's Legacy
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; two flat wins in 2022 included over this trip at Killarney; good runs this year at Gowran and when close third back at Killarney; bit to find with Gaoth Chuil on recent Killarney run though.
runners.comment: 2m1f Killarney winner but bit to find with Gaoth Chuil on recent run there; reserve

runners.name: Rock Of Ireland
runners.spotlight: Successful yard debut on seasonal return at the Curragh in March (1m4f, heavy) and has run well on both turf starts since over same trip; stamina unproven over this far.
runners.comment: Nicely progressive at 1m4f on softer ground this season; stamina unproven over this far

runners.name: Ben Hur
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; Fairyhouse 3yo maiden hurdle winner in December safely held in Grade 2 at Leopardstown later in month; best work at the finish on all three flat maiden runs so potential improver upped in trip here on handicap debut.
runners.comment: Potential improver upped in trip here on handicap debut; reserve

runners.name: Ocean Of Dreams
runners.spotlight: Hasn't added to Leopardstown 2yo success, placed over mid-distances in Britain last year; back from a break with tongue-tie tried but hard to make a convincing case for.
runners.comment: Back from a break with tongue-tie tried but hard to make a convincing case for

runners.name: Sea Eagle
runners.spotlight: Both flat wins in 2024 came at Roscommon; generally below best in recent years, never sighted at the Curragh on fast ground latest; wide draw, hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Yet to hit form this year, fast ground against him latest; wide draw, hard to fancy

races.race_name: Spillers Future Champions Apprentice Handicap

runners.name: Best Rate
runners.spotlight: Bang-in-form 4yo who comes here after emphatic wins under Seamus Cronin at Ascot and Pontefract (both 1m, good to firm) this month; competes off career-high mark but must be considered in current mood.
runners.comment: Bang-in-form 4yo who comes here after emphatic wins at Ascot and Pontefract; major player

runners.name: Happy Banner
runners.spotlight: Four good runs this season, the latest a close second at Epsom (8.5f, good to firm; first-time cheekpieces) three weeks ago; went  up 3lb for that but the form was boosted when the winner followed up on Friday; ought to be right in the thick of things again.
runners.comment: Four good runs this season, the latest a close second behind a next-time-out winner

runners.name: Farasi Lane
runners.spotlight: Probably better known for his AW exploits nowadays but he led close home to cause 28-1 surprise on recent stable debut at Ripon (1m, good), his ninth career success; nudged up only 1lb for that and is a rare runner here for his Middleham-based trainer; respected.
runners.comment: Led close home to win on recent stable debut at Ripon and is only 1lb higher here

runners.name: Jungle Ruler
runners.spotlight: Dual AW winner (7f/6f) who kept on for respectable third of six here (7f, good to firm) this month; needs to find something extra today but his pedigree and running style suggest he's well worth a go over 1m.
runners.comment: Kept on for third over 7f here this month and looks well worth a go over 1m

runners.name: Brocklesby Bill
runners.spotlight: Bettered low-key debut when narrow winner of Chepstow maiden (7f, good to firm) in May but was last of four on recent handicap/AW debut; remains lightly raced and might be happier back on turf but others appeal more.
runners.comment: Narrow winner of 7f maiden in May but last of four when switched to a handicap this month

races.race_name: Spillers Handicap

runners.name: Rage Of Thunder
runners.spotlight: Came from the rear to score at Newbury last month and was placed off today's mark at Epsom (also 6f, good to firm) three weeks ago; can probably cope with this drop back to a stiff 5f but he'll need some luck from stall 1 and his tendency to start slowly is also a worry.
runners.comment: In good form over 6f lately but will need some luck from stall 1
runners.owner: B D Haynes, G L Moore, Alan Jamieson

runners.name: Justcallmepete
runners.spotlight: Ended 2025 with three consecutive 6f AW wins and was successful twice on turf in the spring (5.7f/6f); does not have much margin for error off current mark, though, and this 63rd career start is his first over 5f.
runners.comment: Dual winner this spring (5.7f/6f); on tough mark now, though, and unraced over 5f

runners.name: Atticum
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 3yo who began this season with two perfectly respectable runs (one over C&D) and did well to take modest third after losing ground at the start at Redcar (5f, good) last month; edging down the weights; big player if he breaks on terms.
runners.comment: Running respectably this season and edging down the weights; can make presence felt

runners.name: Wheels Of Fire
runners.spotlight: Showed career-best form when winning readily at Musselburgh (5f, soft) in April and is also effective on fast ground but his subsequent efforts this spring were underwhelming; non-runner at Goodwood yesterday.
runners.comment: Career-best form when winning in April but subsequent spring form was underwhelming

runners.name: Army Bugler
runners.spotlight: Won Leicester maiden (5f, good to firm) last summer; may not have been suited by good to soft ground when disappointing on final 2yo start but has fitness to prove after ten-month break; has been gelded.
runners.comment: Won fast-ground Leicester maiden last summer but has fitness to prove after 306-day break

runners.name: Hypnotised
runners.spotlight: Absent since disappointing seasonal/handicap debut over C&D in April and has the wing draw today but he was gelded during his three-month break and could still have significant potential.
runners.comment: Absent since disappointing seasonal/handicap debut over C&D in April but still unexposed

races.race_name: Chasemore Farm EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Quest For Stars
runners.spotlight: Cost 700,000euros as a yearling and is out of a French 1m 2yo Listed winner; defied market weakness when narrow winner of valuable Doncaster novice (7f, good to firm) three weeks ago and sets a useful form standard.
runners.comment: Out of a Listed 2yo winner and won valuable Doncaster novice on recent debut

runners.name: Lancaster Tower
runners.spotlight: Third foal; half-brother to winners Crown Estate (1m; RPR 100) and Portcullis (1m; 97); dam French 1,000 Guineas winner, half-sister to 7f Listed winner Top Score; makes strong appeal on paper.
runners.comment: Out of a French 1,000 Guineas winner and makes strong appeal on paper
runners.owner: HM The King & HM The Queen

runners.name: King High
runners.spotlight: 320,000gns yearling; eighth foal; half-brother to four winners including Running Lion (1m/1m2f including 2yo/Group 2; RPR 116), Majestic Glory (6f/7f 2yo including Group 3; 99) and Cozone (1m2f/2m, 87); dam 1m1f/1m2f winner (92); interesting newcomer.
runners.comment: 320,000gns yearling half-brother to Group 2 winner Running Lion; interesting newcomer

runners.name: Dancing Dunes
runners.spotlight: 115,000euros yearling; fifth foal; half-brother to German Derby winner Dardanos and three other German winners (one at Listed level); dam French/German 1m2f-1m4f winner; likely to need much further than 7f to be seen to best effect.
runners.comment: 115,000euros yearling; half-brother to a German Derby winner; might find 7f a bit sharp

runners.name: Grove Street
runners.spotlight: 200,000gns foal; first foal; dam 1m/1m4f winner (RPR 98), half-sister to winners Lovely Memory (1m) and Folk Melody (7f 2yo; dam of top-class 1m-1m2f performer Romantic Warrior), out of Canadian 1m2f Grade 1 winner; good market support will bring him into the equation.
runners.comment: First foal from a useful middle-distance winner; cost 200,000gns; market may guide

runners.name: Secano
runners.spotlight: Has two Australian Group winners among his siblings but was never better than midfield when 66-1 for recent debut at Newbury (6f, good to firm).
runners.comment: Never better than midfield when 66-1 for recent debut at Newbury (6f)
runners.owner: Oti Racing P Inglett S De Zoete &partner

races.race_name: Spillers Winners Handicap

runners.name: Home Hero
runners.spotlight: 0-6; encouraging third on 1m2f Chester handicap debut and reappearance but has failed to built on it twice since; needs a drop back in trip and different headgear (first-time visor replaces cheekpieces) to help spark a revival.
runners.comment: Third on 1m2f handicap debut but disappointing since; drop in trip and visor need to help

runners.name: Sydney Rock
runners.spotlight: Runner-up over 7f on all three 2yo starts but has failed to beat a rival in two handicaps this time round; well handicapped if recapturing her juvenile form, particularly with a useful claimer taking 5lb off, but a leap of faith is needed.
runners.comment: Second on all three 2yo starts but has failed to beat a rival in two handicaps this year

runners.name: Galba
runners.spotlight: Best effort when keeping-on third over 7f here (good) in June, his second handicap; sold out of Richard Hannon's yard for 25,000gns this month; the way he kept on here last time suggests the return to 1m may help; leading claims with new stable among the winners.
runners.comment: Kept on for third in 7f course handicap latest; returns to 1m for new yard; key player

runners.name: Sogniamo
runners.spotlight: Left last year's debut behind when springing an 80-1 surprise in 1m1f novice at Hamilton (good to firm) on her reappearance in May but has disappointed in two handicaps since; still early days but hard to be confident.
runners.comment: Well held in two handicaps since 80-1 Hamilton novice win

runners.name: Bennyworth
runners.spotlight: Nine-race maiden who was second on his handicap debut in April but has gone backwards since, including always behind at Epsom only 13 days ago.
runners.comment: Second on handicap debut in the spring but has gone backwards since

runners.name: Next Guilian
runners.spotlight: Placed in sole German start; fifth is the best he's managed in a trio of 1m maiden/novice events (good to firm-good to soft) since coming to Britain but handicaps provide him with a much more realistic chance of success and his yard is in form.
runners.comment: May do better in handicaps for his in-form stable

runners.name: Ingemar
runners.spotlight: Well held in his three runs (1m-1m2f); pulled hard on the first two and has a hood added for handicap debut; bred to be better than a lowly opening mark of 60.
runners.comment: Well held all three starts but bred to be better than a mark of 60; hooded first time

runners.name: Santiago Boy
runners.spotlight: Failed to progress in his qualifying runs and his hopes are pinned on first-time blinkers sparking improvement now switching to handicaps.
runners.comment: Hasn't progressed in qualifying runs and blinkers need to help now handicapping

runners.name: Terranoble
runners.spotlight: Improved with each of his three runs on the AW, winning novice at Wolverhampton in January, but he failed to beat a rival in two turf handicaps in the spring; needs to recapture his AW form back from a break.
runners.comment: Started well on AW but has failed to beat a rival in two handicaps on turf; off 67 days

races.race_name: Spillers Fillies' Handicap

runners.name: Spirit Of Athene
runners.spotlight: Ended three-race 2yo campaign with 1m AW win in December and was close second when upped to 1m2f for this month's seasonal/handicap/turf debut at Salisbury (good to firm); has obvious scope to build upon that performance here and benefits from Ashley Lewis' useful 5lb claim; good chance.
runners.comment: Went close when upped to 1m2f for this month's seasonal/handicap/turf debut; good chance

runners.name: Lady Milton
runners.spotlight: Gained all three wins on AW but was placed on turf here (1m, good) and at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm) on last two appearances; still unexposed over today's trip; likely contender again.
runners.comment: Gained all three wins on AW but was placed on last two turf starts (one here); in the mix

runners.name: Enamorus
runners.spotlight: Six-race maiden; kept of for third when upped to 8.4f and fitted with cheekpieces at Beverley (good to firm) this month and looks worth a crack at this even longer trip but others in this field have more persuasive profiles.
runners.comment: Kept on for third when upped to 8.4f this month but is now 0-6; others appeal more

runners.name: Ammoony
runners.spotlight: Came good at fifth attempt, at Redcar (1m2f, good) ten weeks ago; not seen since but the front pair drew clear in that race and she shaped as though this stiffer track might suit her better; high on the list.
runners.comment: Absent since breakthrough win ten weeks ago but remains unexposed after only five runs

runners.name: Come On Eibhlin
runners.spotlight: Quite well handicapped if judged on this spring's placed form over 7f/1m and may not have been suited by the contours of Beverley when upped to 8.4f this month (still ran okay); has a fighting chance if stamina holds out over this even longer trip; tongue-tie added.
runners.comment: Well handicapped on this spring's placed form over 7f/1m; tries a new trip
runners.owner: Hold My Beer, Gee Gees Racing & N Clark

runners.name: Melody De Vega
runners.spotlight: Travelled well before asserting at Leicester (1m2f, good to firm) a fortnight ago, opening her account at the eighth attempt; contests a deeper race here but is only 3lb higher; ought to make her presence felt.
runners.comment: Raised only 3lb for recent Leicester win and ought to make her presence felt again
runners.owner: Michael P Tudor & J P M O'Connor

runners.name: Pershalla
runners.spotlight: Caused 40-1 surprise off today's mark at Kempton (1m4f, AW) in April but has been below that form lately, including when last of seven in similar race to this over C&D on Thursday.
runners.comment: Surprise AW winner in April but well below that form lately

runners.name: Take A View
runners.spotlight: Unexposed 3yo who made the frame in all three qualifying races, albeit a shade disappointing when well-held third of five over 1m last time; back up in trip for this handicap debut and probably still has potential.
runners.comment: Unexposed 3yo who made the frame in a three qualifying races; handicap debut today

runners.name: Kimeko Glory
runners.spotlight: Not at best on any of four starts since returned to turf in April, most recently when towards rear throughout at Newbury this month, but now 1lb lower than when dominating this race from the front a year ago; can't be ruled out.
runners.comment: Below best since returned to turf in April but won this race from the front in 2025

runners.name: Celestias Comet
runners.spotlight: Did not progress after last September's AW novice win but looked back in good nick when cosily exploiting much-reduced mark at Nottingham (1m2f, good to firm) this month; this race is much stronger but a 3lb rise ought to be manageable if she's in similar form again.
runners.comment: Cosily exploited much-reduced mark at Nottingham this month, and went back up only 3lb
runners.owner: Mr & Mrs Dowling And & Mrs Marney

races.race_name: Spillers Spectacular Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Kakirra
runners.spotlight: Progressive 3yo who made it 4-4 in handicaps and 2-2 on turf when winning by a neck at Newbury (13.5f, good to firm) 20 days ago, showing a fine attitude; now 5lb higher but there could still be more to come from this improver.
runners.comment: Made it 4-4 in handicaps and 2-2 on turf when winning at Newbury; respected off 5lb higher

runners.name: Boilermaker
runners.spotlight: Ran well when upped to 1m4f at Thirsk (good) in May and has run to a similar level in both starts since, including when second of five at Doncaster (1m4f, good to firm; first-time cheekpieces) 11 days ago; claims if seeing out this longer trip.
runners.comment: Ran to a similar level in each of his last three starts (1m4f);  up in trip with claims
runners.owner: W G & A G Vestey, E Gerber And P Inglett

runners.name: Last Verse
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the fifth attempt when making all in first-time cheekpieces off 6lb lower at Chepstow (1m4f, good to firm) 26 days ago; has since left Andrew Balding (bought for 20,000gns) and this well-bred gelding steps up in trip for his stable debut.
runners.comment: Made all at Chepstow over 1m4f off 6lb lower last time; up in trip for his stable debut

runners.name: Outflank
runners.spotlight: Ran to a similar level in each of his first three starts (1m2f-1m4f) and he was reported to have been unsuited by the going when failing to beat a rival home on his handicap debut at Newmarket (1m4f, good; first-time blinkers; trainer's representative said he would prefer it slower) last month; steps up in trip with a bit better needed.
runners.comment: Reported to have been unsuited by the going on his handicap debut last month; up in trip

races.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Fairy Well
runners.spotlight: Cost 180,000gns as a yearling; outsider of six on debut at Nottingham this month (6f, good to firm) but managed fourth to yard's other runner; showed obvious signs of greenness there and can improve.
runners.comment: Fourth to yard's other runner on debut; showed obvious signs of greenness and can improve

runners.name: Caravel
runners.spotlight: This half-sister to four winners showed only minor promise on debut at Doncaster and at Newmarket four weeks later; more is needed back in trip.
runners.comment: Just minor promise first two starts; more is needed back in trip

runners.name: Sioux Moon
runners.spotlight: Sixth foal; closely related to winners Marrakech Moon (7f/1m, including 2yo/France; RPR 95) and Mr Marrakech (7f AW; 93) and half-sister to two other winners at up to 1m4f; dam 5f-6.5f winner (including USA; 90); trainer has had a few 2yo winners this year, including first time out; market check advised.
runners.comment: Trainer has had a few 2yo winners this year, including first time out; watch market

runners.name: Coat Of Red
runners.spotlight: Cost 220,000gns as a yearling and is a half-sister to dual Group 2 winner Chindit; well backed on debut at Goodwood in May (6f, good) and showed up well for a long way before her early exertions/immaturity told; good step forward highly likely.
runners.comment: Showed up well for a long way on debut; good step forward highly likely

races.race_name: Every Race Live On Racing TV Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Amber Ocean
runners.spotlight: Confirmed promise of debut second on AW in April (form worked out well) when beating the odds-on favourite at Chepstow 13 days ago (also 5f; good to firm); could well make a winning start in nurseries.
runners.comment: Done little wrong so far and could easily make a winning start in nurseries

runners.name: Wolf's Gallop
runners.spotlight: Improver in RPR terms and showed a lot of speed at Windsor last time with only the 2-9 favourite and a runner who went on to finish second to Amber Ocean going by in the final furlong; can step forward again in this his first nursery.
runners.comment: Improver in RPR terms and showed a lot of speed at Windsor last time; nursery debut
runners.owner: Fairies At The Bottom Of The Garden Ltd

runners.name: My Maria
runners.spotlight: Ran to RPR of 63 or 64 each start, most recently on nursery debut at Yarmouth three weeks ago; could have done without a 2lb rise for being beaten over a length; yard ended quiet spell with 16-1 winner yesterday.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten into second on nursery bow but up 2lb; yard back with 16-1 winner yesterday

runners.name: Penny Arcade
runners.spotlight: Claimed out of Karl Burke's yard for 20,000gns in May; the step up to 6f looked in her favour when starting out for new connections at Ripon six weeks ago but she bombed out; the ridges at that track aren't for everyone and you can probably put a line through that effort; redemption might be tricky back over 5f here; nursery debut.
runners.comment: Nursery debut; redemption might be tricky back over 5f

runners.name: Pretty Little Baby
runners.spotlight: Recorded RPR of 59 when third on debut at Thirsk in May (5f, good) and ran to same figure/filled same position at Hamilton the following month (5f, good to firm; sent off evens); failed to quicken once in the clear last time and is opposable kept to the minimum trip for nursery debut.
runners.comment: Failed to quicken once in the clear latest and is opposable kept to 5f for nursery debut

runners.name: Pj's Corner
runners.spotlight: Improved as he's dropped back in trip from 7f and showed plenty of zip when third of 11 at Bath four weeks ago (5.7f, firm); looks well worth a go over the bare 5f; considered on nursery debut.
runners.comment: Looks well worth a go over the bare 5f; considered on nursery debut

races.race_name: Leicester Racecourse Ideal Self-Hire Wedding Venue Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Moving Shadow
runners.spotlight: Justified favouritism on debut over C&D last September (good to soft) but he raced too freely for his own good when trying to defy the same 7lb penalty as tonight at Newmarket the following month (also 7f, good); not seen since but was gelded in his time off; could be the answer.
runners.comment: Justified favouritism on debut over C&D then too free for his own good after; gelded since

runners.name: Yordan
runners.spotlight: 160,000gns yearling; sixth foal; Starman half-brother to three winners (5f-1m1f); dam 7f AW winner (RPR 65); already gelded; this looks a good starting point and market can guide.
runners.comment: 160,000gns yearling; has been gelded; this looks a good starting point; watch the market

runners.name: Siwa Oasis
runners.spotlight: Has achieved similar RPRs in all four starts but latest effort (here) was underwhelming given he'd shaped so well over that 1m2f trip at Newbury the time before; this strong traveller could get away with dropping back to 7f and is a key player.
runners.comment: Ideal trip still unknown but has the form to play a serious role

runners.name: Winston's Oath
runners.spotlight: Uncompetitive in bumpers/over hurdles for Dylan Cunha and changed hands for 6,000gns this month; new trainer is more than capable of turning things around but 7f might be on the sharp side; rivals are all 3yos.
runners.comment: In very good hands but might find 7f sharp enough on Flat debut

races.race_name: Remembering Mike Furlong Handicap

runners.name: Melissa Honey
runners.spotlight: Placed just once in first 13 starts but has hit form of late, defeating 15 rivals at Doncaster last month (6f) and did the business over C&D (also good to firm) 25 days ago; her second in between those wins is strong form for the grade; will take all the beating off just 2lb higher than last time.
runners.comment: Won either side of excellent second; just 2lb higher than last time; tough to beat

runners.name: Von Krolock
runners.spotlight: Beaten after trading at 1.23 in running at Wolverhampton in March, then recorded third win for James Owen there (6f; beat Rye by 2l); having first run on turf for the yard when weakening into sixth over C&D when last seen in April; absence of regular headgear is a concern this evening.
runners.comment: Absence of regular headgear is a concern back from 95 days off

runners.name: Rye
runners.spotlight: Runner-up for the seventh time at Windsor in May but couldn't build on that when looking awkward at Goodwood last time (had run well sole previous visit); opposable even though yard took this last year.
runners.comment: Opposable given latest disappointment and her record of 0-18

runners.name: Last Outlaw
runners.spotlight: Failed to beat a rival on stable debut at Wolverhampton last month when returning from 137 days off (typically started slowly); tongue-tie returns and is a dual winner on turf (5f; one on good to firm) but hard to support.
runners.comment: Failed to beat a rival on stable debut at Wolverhampton last month; hard to support

runners.name: Tomarlo
runners.spotlight: Having third start for new connections when making virtually all over this trip at Wolverhampton this month; a definite player if subsequent defeat off this revised mark can be attributed to 7f rather than his first taste of ground quicker than good.
runners.comment: Could get back on track if 7f rather than fast ground was to blame for recent defeat

runners.name: Calafrio
runners.spotlight: Achieved one of her best RPRs when back from a break at Thirsk last April (runner-up; 6f, good) and when starting out for George Baker following a break at Kempton in November (6f; won when sporting this headgear combination for the first time); not quite so effective in two runs since but yard is now red hot; respected; withdrawn after showing reluctance to post at Salisbury recently.
runners.comment: Goes well fresh and yard red hot; respected

races.race_name: Join Racing TV Today Handicap

runners.name: Clocker
runners.spotlight: Broke on terms for the first time and was able to dictate before showing good battling qualities to get back up at Hamilton 18 days ago; that was her first crack at a trip as far as 1m3f and some extra yardage here will suit even better; will likely encounter similar ground this evening; the one to beat off 3lb higher.
runners.comment: Breakthrough win was hard fought; up 3lb; extra yardage here will suit even better

runners.name: This Rib
runners.spotlight: Ran much better than in first two handicaps when upped significantly in trip to 1m5f at Ayr last time but he'll need to learn to settle if he's to see these kind of distances out.
runners.comment: Will need to learn to settle if he's to be highly competitive over middle distances

runners.name: Al's River
runners.spotlight: No real impact in 1m2f/1m3f handicaps following break/gelding operation then ran poorly in first-time headgear (blinkers) over 1m4f; less severe headgear goes on here and he'll likely encounter genuine fast ground for the first time.
runners.comment: Handicap form so far reads no real impact times two then lacklustre latest

runners.name: Captain Cairney
runners.spotlight: Front-runner; checked out quickly at Salisbury on Saturday but could easily bounce back given he left a poor run behind when turned out just nine days later earlier in the month.
runners.comment: Checked out quickly at Salisbury on Saturday but has previous for bouncing back
runners.owner: J O'Mulloy And W R Muir

races.race_name: Nelson Panoramic Restaurant Dining Packages From Just £90 Handicap

runners.name: Spiritoftheblues
runners.spotlight: Ready winner on debut at Ayr last August (7f) and bounced back from a couple of lesser efforts to be runner-up in first handicap this June (8.3f, Hamilton); second crack at 1m2f when beaten 6l into third at the scene of her win latest; that trip may want revisiting at some stage but she makes some appeal over 1m here.
runners.comment: 1m2f may want revisiting at some stage but she makes some appeal over 1m here

runners.name: Cancelled
runners.spotlight: Cheekpieces added to tongue-tie when making the frame in deeper contest over the extended mile at Beverley last time, dropped in from widest draw before unable to sustain a promising run once negotiating traffic problems; should be able to adopt a better track position this time.
runners.comment: Ran well in deeper contest last time, all things considered

runners.name: Battosai
runners.spotlight: Best effort for Brian Meehan came over 1m2f (managed second) and was last seen stretching out to 1m4f; changed hands for 14,000gns this month; this won't take much winning and a positive market move would look significant; goes without headgear.
runners.comment: This won't take much winning and a positive market move on yard bow would look significant

runners.name: Silken Bay
runners.spotlight: Proved 50-1 win in five-runner Southwell maiden on second start to be no fluke when running well under a penalty at Haydock next time; overracing in both handicap starts proved terminal, particularly when attempting to see out 1m2f for the first time 59 days ago; change of jockey this evening.
runners.comment: Overracing in both handicap starts proved terminal; change of jockey this evening

runners.name: Special Ghaiyyath
runners.spotlight: Signed off for Charlie Johnston/kicked off for James Tate in winning form; last or second last in four starts for current connections (ridden forward each time) and can only be watched; goes without headgear.
runners.comment: Last or second last in four starts for current connections and can only be watched

races.race_name: Qatar International Stakes (Group 1 Purebred Arabian)

runners.name: HM Alchahine (Fr)
runners.spotlight: The top-rated Arabian in training, having won eleven of his sixteen starts, three of them Group 1's; didn't seem to stay behind Lippo De Carrere in Qatar in February and didn't have a smooth passage at Abu Dhabi after that; was far too keen in France last time out and hopefully that run will have taken the fizz out of him; if he's back to his best, he's the one to beat. Official BHA Rating 129

runners.name: Lippo De Carrere (Fr)
runners.spotlight: Given a marvellous ride by Mickael Barzalona to win the UK Arabian Derby last year; took his form to a new level though when beating Al Ghadeer (three-time winner of this race) in the Amir's Sword; not as good at Longchamp in May but the soft ground may well have been a factor; solid claims granted a strong pace to chase. Official BHA Rating 125

runners.name: Al Sharid (Fr)
runners.spotlight: Improving four-year-old who's won his last three starts despite idling very badly in the closing stages; clearly, he keeps a bit back for himself but there's no real knowing where his ceiling might lie; that said it will require a huge personal best to get involved in this company. Official BHA Rating 95

runners.name: Rb Kingmaker (Usa)
runners.spotlight: Four-time globetrotting Group 1 winner who was supplemented for this race last week; at his best on quick ground which he didn't get at Longchamp in May when he was behind a couple of these. Better expected here despite this trip probably being a bit shorter than ideal. Official BHA Rating 127

runners.name: Hajmah (Fr)
runners.spotlight: Won last year's French Derby and followed up with a second win in Group 1 company at Longchamp in the Autumn; hasn't been at her best in two runs this year and was well behind three of these at Longchamp in May; remains lightly raced, so it would be dangerous to rule her out. Official BHA Rating 117

runners.name: Lacaro Du Croate (Fr)
runners.spotlight: Dual Group 1 winner who's only once been out of the frame; behind RB Kingmaker in Saudi Arabia earlier in the year but reversed that form at Longchamp in May when last seen; yard having a great season with the Arabians in Europe and she can't be ruled out. Official BHA Rating 120
runners.owner: Mr Mansoor Khalil M. Al Shahwani

runners.name: Rb Burn The Bill (Usa)
runners.spotlight: Won four of her five starts in America her last one coming over this trip; looked as though the experience of Turf was needed on her French debut before taking her form to a new level winning a Group 1 race in Milan on an artificial surface narrowly beating Lino; gets weight all round and remains open to improvement, but more probably needed in a very strong renewal. Official BHA Rating 112

runners.name: Mureb (Fr)
runners.spotlight: Won a Group 2 race as a three-year-old and won a minor race in Qatar over the winter; highly likely he's in here to be a pacemaker for his stable companion Lippo De Carrere. Official BHA Rating 105

runners.name: Lino (Fr)
runners.spotlight: Improving front runner who won a Group 3 contest in Morocco at the end of last year; this year has finished second in two Group 1 races in Qatar and most recently in Italy; will give it a good go from the front but likely to be vulnerable in the closing stages. Official BHA Rating 115
runners.owner: Mr Yannick Schulz & Mr Eric Dell'Ova
